sections.title: The interpretation of the righteous and the wicked.

verses.text: Blessed is the one who walks not in the counsel of the wicked,
The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul;
He shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water,
The ungodly are not so; they are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment,
For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

sections.title: Prophecy Concerning Christ

verses.text: አሕዛብ ለምን ዶለቱ?
የምድር ነገሥታት ተነሡ፥
“ማሰሪያቸውን ከእኛ እንበጥስ፥
በሰማይ የሚኖር እርሱ ይሥቅባቸዋል።
በዚያን ጊዜ በቍጣው ይናገራቸዋል፥
እኔ ግን በእነርሱ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኜ ተሾምሁ
የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እናገር ዘንድ፥
ለምነኝ፥ አሕዛብን ለርስትህ
በብረት በትር ትጠብቃቸዋለህ፥
አሁንም እናንት ነገሥታት፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤
ለእግዚአብሔር በፍርሀት ተገዙ፥
ጥበብን አጽኑአት፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳይቈጣ፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when he fled from the face of his son Absalom.

verses.text: O Lord, how greatly do they trouble me!
Many are they who seek my life;
But Thou, O Lord, art my refuge;
With my voice I cried unto the Lord;
I laid me down and slept;
From those who rise up against me and those who trouble me
Arise, O Lord, my God; save me;
Salvation is of the Lord;

sections.title: A Psalm of David for the Chief Musician, upon the Gittith.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን በጠራሁት ጊዜ ጽድቄን ሰማኝ፥
እናንት የሰው ልጆች፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ
እግዚአብሔር በጻድቁ እንደ ተገለጠ ዕወቁ፤
ተቈጡ፥ ነገር ግን አትበድሉ፤
የጽድቅን መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ታመኑ።
“በጎውን ማን ያሳየናል?” የሚሉ ብዙዎች ናቸው።
በልባችን ደስታን ጨመርህ፤
በእርሱ በሰላም እተኛለሁ፥ አንቀላፋለሁም፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, in Washington.

verses.text: O Lord, hear my cry,
fulfill the word of my supplication,
in the morning, let my voice be heard,
for Thou art not a God who delights in wickedness;
neither shall evildoers dwell in Thy sight.
Thou shalt destroy all who speak falsehood;
but I, in the abundance of Thy mercy, will enter into Thy house;
O Lord, lead me in Thy righteousness.
For there is no truth in their mouth;
O Lord, let them be judged, and let them perish in their own counsels.
በአንተ የሚታመኑት ሁሉ ግን ደስ ይላቸዋል፤
አንተ ጻድቁን ትባርከዋለህና፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, concerning the eighth.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥
ድውይ ነኝና አቤቱ፥ ይቅር በለኝ፤
ነፍሴም እጅግ ታወከች፤
አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ ነፍሴንም አድናት፥
በሞት የሚያስብህ የለምና፥
በጭንቀቴ ደክሜአለሁ፤
ዐይኔ ከቍጣ የተነሣ ታወከች፤
ዐመፃን የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥
እግዚአብሔር ልመናዬን ሰማኝ፤
ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይፈሩ፥ ይጐስቁሉም፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, concerning the man of Benjamin, for the Lord.

verses.text: O Lord, my God, in Thee do I put my trust; let me not be ashamed.
Let not my soul be like a lion that teareth in pieces.
O Lord my God, if I have done this;
If there be iniquity in my hands, let me return evil for evil.
The enemy pursueth my soul; he hath smitten me.
O Lord, arise in Thy anger.
Let the assembly of the people be gathered unto Thee.
The Lord shall judge the people.
The wicked shall not be justified.
The Lord shall help me in truth.
እግዚአብሔር የእውነት ዳኛ ነው፤
ባትመለሱ ግን ሰይፉን ይመዝዛል፥
የሚገድል መርዝንም አዘጋጀበት፤
እነሆ፥ ዐመፀኛ በዐመፁ ተጨነቀ፤
ጕድጓድንም ማሰ፥ ቈፈረም።
ጉዳቱ በራሱ ይመለሳል፥
እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ጽድቁ መጠን አመሰግናለሁ፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician, in Washington.

verses.text: O Lord, our Master, Your name is greatly praised throughout all the earth,
You have prepared praise from the mouths of infants and nursing children,
I have heard the work of Your fingers, O heavens,
What is man that You are mindful of him?
You have made him a little lower than the angels;
And You have crowned him with glory and honor.
Both the sheep and the oxen,
The birds of the air and the fish of the sea,
O Lord, our Master, Your name is greatly praised throughout all the earth.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, to be sung by the chief musician, concerning the death of the beloved.

verses.text: O Lord, with my whole heart I give thanks unto Thee,
In Thee I find joy, and I shall make mirth;
When mine enemies turned back,
Thou hast made my judgment and my cause prevail;
Thou hast rebuked the nations, and the wicked have perished;
The enemies have perished forever,
But the Lord shall endure forever;
He shall judge the world in righteousness.
The Lord also shall be a refuge for the needy;
All who love Thy name shall put their trust in Thee,
በጽዮን ለሚኖር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥
ደማቸውን የሚመራመር እርሱ አስቦአልና፥
አቤቱ፥ ይቅር በለኝ፥ ጠላቶቼም የሚያመጡብኝን መከራ እይ፥
ምስጋናውን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ፤
አሕዛብ በሠሩት በደላቸው ጠፉ፥
እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ማድረግ ያውቃል፤
ኀጢአተኞች ወደ ሲኦል ይመለሱ፥
ድሃ ለዘለዓለም የሚረሳ አይደለምና፥
አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፥ ሰውም አይበርታ፥
አቤቱ፥ የሕግ መምህርን በላያቸው ላይ ሹም፤
አቤቱ፥ ለምን ርቀህ ቆምህ?
በኀጢአተኛ ትዕቢት ድሃ ይናደዳል፤
ኀጢአተኛ በነፍሱ ፈቃድ ይወደሳል፥
ኀጢአተኛ እግዚአብሔርን አበሳጨው፥
መንገዱ ሁሉ የረከሰ ነው፥
በልቡ ይላል፥ “ለልጅ ልጅ አልታወክም
አፉ መርገምንና ሽንገላን የተመላ ነው፤
ከባለጸጎች ጋር ይሸምቃል፥ ያድድናልም
እንደ አንበሳ በጕድጓድ በስውር ይሸምቃል፤
በወጥመዱም ያዋርደዋል፥
በልቡም ይላል፥ “እግዚአብሔር ረስቶኛል፤
አቤቱ፥ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ እጅህም ከፍ ከፍ ትበል፤
ኀጢአተኛ ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣው?
አንተ ድካምንና ቍጣን እንድትመለከት ታያለህን?
የኀጢአተኛንና የክፉን ክንድ ስበር፥
እግዚአብሔር ለዘለዓለም ይነግሣል፤
እግዚአብሔር የድሆችን ምኞት ሰማ፥
ፍርዱ ለድሃ አደግና ለችግረኛ ይደረግ ዘንድ፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: In the Lord do I put my trust;
Behold, the sinners, for they have struck their own cords;
Thou art the work of Thy hands; behold, they have destroyed it;
The Lord is in His holy temple;
The Lord examines the righteous and the wicked;
And He will rain coals upon the wicked;
For the Lord is righteous; He loves righteousness.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, concerning the eighth.

verses.text: O Lord, deliver me, for I am a man who cannot stand.
They speak vain things among themselves;
The Lord shall destroy all the horns of the wicked.
"We shall strengthen our voices;
"Concerning the affliction of the poor, and the cry of the captives
upon the earth, as if it were broken, seven times also as if it were cast down like silver.
O Lord, You keep us;
the wicked shall surround them.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ፈጽመህ ትረሳኛለህ?
እስከ መቼ በነፍሴ ኀዘንን አኖራለሁ?
አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ተመልከተኝ ስማኝም፤
የሚያስጨንቁኝም እኔ ብናወጥ ደስ እንዳይላቸው፥
እኔ ግን በቸርነትህ ታመንሁ፥
የረዳኝን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግነዋለሁ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: The fool in his heart says, "There is no God."
He who is wise, let him not be as one who seeks the Lord in vain.
All things are established in unity.
Their graves are opened like a tomb.
Beneath their mouths lies the venom of serpents.
Their feet are swift to shed blood.
They devour my people as one eats bread.
And there they tremble, for the one who does not terrify them shall terrify them.
You have rejected the counsel of the poor.
Who shall give the Redeemer from Zion to Israel?

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ማን ያድራል?
በቅንነት የሚሄድ፥ ጽድቅንም የሚያደርግ፥
በአንደበቱ የማይሸነግል፥
ኀጢአተኛ በፊቱ የተናቀ፥
ገንዘቡን በአራጣ የማያበድር፥

sections.title: The Psalm of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና ጠብቀኝ።
እግዚአብሔርን አልሁት፥ “አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ፤
ፈቃድህ ሁሉ በምድር ባሉት ቅዱሳን ላይ ተገለጠ።
ደዌያቸው በዛ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ተፋጠኑ፤
እግዚአብሔር የርስቴ ዕድል ፋንታና ጽዋዬ ነው፥
ይይዙኝ ዘንድ ገመድ ጣሉብኝ፥
እንዳስተውል ያደረገኝን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግነዋለሁ፤
ሁልጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን በፊቴ አየዋለሁ፤
ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው፥ ምላሴም ሐሤት አደረገ፤
ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥
የሕይወትን መንገድ አሳየኸኝ፤

sections.title: The Prayer of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ጽድቄን ስማኝ፥ ልመናዬንም አድምጠኝ፤
ፍርዴ ከፊትህ ይወጣል፥
በሌሊትም ጐበኘኸኝ፤ ልቤንም ፈተንኸው፥
የሰውን ሥራ አፌ እንዳይናገር፥
ሰኰናዬ እንዳይናወጥ አረማመዴን በመንገድህ አጽና።
እግዚአብሔር ሰምቶኛልና እኔ ጮኽሁ፤
ቀኝህን ከሚቃወሟት፥
እንደ ዐይን ብሌን ጠብቀኝ፤
ከሚያጐሳቍሉኝ ኃጥኣን ፊት፥
አንጀታቸውን ቋጠሩ፥
Now, I beseech Thee; do not forsake me.
They are like a lion that roars for its prey.
O Lord, arise, and let Thy mercy reach them.
Thy sword is in Thy hand against mine adversaries.
But I, in Thy righteousness, shall not be forsaken.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, the servant of the Lord, which he spake unto the Lord in the day when the Lord had delivered him from the hand of Saul and from all his enemies.

verses.text: O Lord, I love Thee with all my strength.
The Lord is my strength, my fortress, my deliverer,
In the time when I called upon the Lord,
The cords of death encompassed me, and the floods of ungodliness made me afraid;
The snares of Sheol confronted me;
In my distress, I called upon the Lord,
The earth shook and trembled; it quaked and was shaken;
From His wrath, smoke went up, and fire devoured before Him;
He made the heavens bow down and came down;
He rode upon a cherub and flew; He soared upon the wings of the wind.
መሰወሪያውን ጨለማ አደረገ፤
በፊቱ ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ደመናትና በረዶ
እግዚአብሔርም በሰማያት አንጐደጐደ፥
ፍላጻውን ላከ፥ በተናቸውም፤
አቤቱ፥ ከተግሣጽህ፥
ከአርያም ላከ፥ ወሰደኝም፥
ከብርቱዎች ጠላቶቼ
በመከራዬ ቀን ደረሱብኝ፤
ወደ ሰፊ ሥፍራም አወጣኝ፤
እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቄ ይሰጠኛል፤
I will keep the way of the Lord,
For all my transgressions were ever before me,
With Him, I shall be pure.
And the Lord shall grant me according to my righteousness.
With the righteous man, thou shalt be righteous;
With the pure man, thou shalt be pure;
Thou wilt save the humble people,
O Lord, Thou art my light;
In Thee, I shall escape from destruction,
The way of my God is pure.
Who is God, except the Lord?
It is the Lord who strengthens me;
He who supports my feet like those of a deer;
He who teaches my hands to wage war;
He has given me a refuge for my safety.
You have gathered my enemies under my feet;
I will crush them; I will look upon them;
I will distress them; they shall not be able to stand;
By the sword, you shall strengthen me;
You have given me the back of my enemies.
ጮኹ፥ የሚረዳቸውም አጡ።
በነፋስ ፊት እንዳለ ትቢያ እፈጫቸዋለሁ፥
ከሕዝብ ክርክር አድነኝ፥
በጆሮ ሰምተው ተገዙልኝ፤
የባዕድ ልጆች አረጁ፥
እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ነው፥ አምላኬም ቡሩክ ነው፥
አምላኬ በቀሌን ይመልስልኛል።
ከጥፉዎች ጠላቶቼ የሚታደገኝ እርሱ ነው፤
አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥
የንጉሡን መድኀኒት ታላቅ ያደርጋታል፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥
ቀን ለቀን ነገርን ታወጣለች፥
ቃላቸው ያልተሰማበት ነገር የለም፥ መናገርም የለም፥
ቃላቸው ወደ ምድር ሁሉ ወጣ።
በፀሐይ ውስጥ ድንኳኑን አደረገ፥
አወጣጡ ከሰማያት ዳርቻ ነው፥
የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ንጹሕ ነው፤ ነፍስንም ይመልሳል፤
የእግዚአብሔር ሥርዐት ቅን ነው፥ ልብንም ደስ ያሰኛል፤
እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ንጹሕ ነው፥ ለዘለዓለምም ይኖራል፤
ከወርቅና ከክቡር ዕንቍ ይልቅ ይወደዳል፤
ባሪያህ ደግሞ ይጠብቀዋል፤
ስሕተትን ማን ያስተውላታል?
ከልዩ ሰው ባሪያህን አድነው።
የአንደበቴ ቃል ያማረ ይሁን፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: በመከራህ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ይስማህ፤
ከመቅደሱ ረድኤትን ይላክልህ፥
መሥዋዕትህን ያስብልህ፤
እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልብህ ይስጥህ
በማዳንህ ደስ ይለናል፤
እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን እንዳዳነው ዛሬ ዐወቅሁ፤
እነዚያ በፈረሶችና በሰረገላዎች ይታመናሉ፤
እነርሱ ተሰነካክለው ወደቁ፤
አቤቱ፥ ንጉሥን አድነው፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: O Lord, in Thy strength the king rejoices;
Thou hast granted the desire of his heart;
For Thou hast brought him good and abundant blessings;
To give him life, Thou hast also granted;
In Thy salvation, Thy glory is great;
For Thou hast bestowed upon him blessings everlasting;
The king trusts in the Lord;
Thy hand shall strike down all his enemies;
When Thy face is angry, make them as chaff before the fire;
Their fruit from the earth,
For calamity hath been brought upon thee,
And thou shalt return unto their rear;
O Lord, in Thy strength, be exalted on high;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, regarding the power of the night, for the chief musician.

verses.text: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ተመልከተኝ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ?
አምላኬ፥ በቀን ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፥ አልሰማኸኝም።
በእስራኤል የተመሰገንህ አንተ ግን በቅዱሳንህ ትኖራለህ።
አባቶቻችን አንተን አመኑ፥
ወደ አንተ ጮኹ፥ ዳኑም፥
እኔ ግን ትል ነኝ፥ ሰውም አይደለሁም፤
የሚያዩኝ ሁሉ ይጠቃቀሱብኛል፤
“በእግዚአብሔር አመነ፥
አንተ ከሆድ አውጥተኸኛልና፥
ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ላይ ተጣልሁ፤
I am troubled, for I am near unto You;
Many bulls have encircled me;
They have gaped upon me like a lion that is eager to tear its prey;
I am poured out like water;
My strength is dried up like a potsherd;
Many dogs have surrounded me;
They have pierced my hands and my feet;
They divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots;
But You, O Lord, be not far from me;
Deliver my soul from the sword.
Deliver me from the mouth of the lion.
I shall declare Thy name unto my brethren.
O ye who fear the Lord, praise Him;
I shall not turn away the cry of the poor, for I am not without compassion.
In the great assembly, my glory is from Thee;
The needy shall eat, and they shall be satisfied;
Let all the borders of the earth remember;
For the kingdom is the Lord's;
All the inhabitants of the earth shall eat and shall worship;
For the seed shall serve Him;
For the people that shall be born.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: The Lord shall keep me; there is none who shall make me to stumble.
He shall lead me in paths of righteousness;
to restore my soul;
even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies;
Your mercy shall follow me all the days of my life;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, the first Sabbath.

verses.text: The earth is the Lord's fullness,
He has established it upon the seas,
Who shall ascend unto the hill of the Lord?
He whose heart is pure, and whose hands are clean,
He shall receive blessing from the Lord,
This generation seeks Him,
O you gates! Lift up your heads,
Who is this King of glory?
O you gates, lift them up!
Who is this King of glory?

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, my God, to Thee I lift up my soul.
O Lord, I trust in Thee; I shall not be forsaken forever.
Those who hope in Thee shall not be put to shame.
O Lord, guide me in Thy way;
Lead me in Thy truth, and teach me.
O Lord, remember Thy mercy;
Do not remember the sins of my youth and my transgressions.
The Lord is good and righteous;
He instructs sinners in the way.
The paths of the Lord are all mercy and truth.
O Lord, for Thy name's sake,
Who is the man that fears the Lord?
His soul shall dwell in goodness,
The strength of the Lord is for those who fear Him,
Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord;
Turn Thy face toward me and save me,
The sorrow of my heart is great;
Behold my affliction and my trouble,
Look upon my enemies, for they are many;
Preserve my soul and deliver me.
O Lord, I have placed my hope in Thee.
The Lord shall deliver Israel from all his afflictions.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, I shall dwell in my integrity; judge me.
O Lord, test me and try me.
Thy mercy is before mine eyes.
I have not sat with vain persons,
I have hated the assembly of evildoers.
I will wash my hands in innocence;
that I may hear the voice of Thy praise.
O Lord, the beauty of Thy house
is with my soul among the wicked.
In their hands is deceit.
እኔ ግን በየዋህነቴ እኖራለሁ፤
እግሮቼ በቅንነት ቆመዋልና፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: The Lord hath delivered me; He hath also saved me;
The wicked shall eat my flesh when they draw near;
Though an army besiege me, my heart shall not fear;
I shall speak one thing unto the Lord; I desire her also;
In the day of my trouble, I shall seek refuge in His dwelling;
Behold, now the Lord hath lifted my head above my enemies;
O Lord, hear my cry unto Thee;
My heart saith unto Thee:
Do not turn Thy face away from me;
For my father and my mother have forsaken me;
አቤቱ መንገድህን አስተምረኝ፥
ለሚያስጨንቁኝ ፈቃድ አትስጠኝ፥
የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት በሕያዋን ምድር
እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, my God, unto Thee do I cry; do not turn away from me.
In the time when I lifted my hands in Thy holy sanctuary,
Do not take my soul away with the wicked;
According to their deeds and as their wickedness deserves, give them their due.
And unto the Lord's work
I have heard the word of my supplication;
The Lord is my helper and my refuge;
The Lord is the strength of His people;
Preserve Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.

verses.text: O children of the Almighty, bring forth unto the Lord,
Bring forth the honor of His name unto the Lord,
The word of the Lord is upon the winds.
The word of the Lord is in power;
The word of the Lord shall break the stronghold.
As the cedar of Lebanon, it shall be mighty.
The word of the Lord shall consume the chaff of fire.
The word of the Lord shall make desolate the wilderness,
The word of the Lord shall strengthen the weak,
The Lord has gathered the waters of destruction;
The Lord shall grant strength unto His people;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the house of the Lord, a song of thanksgiving.

verses.text: O Lord, I have called upon Thee,
O Lord my God, I have cried unto Thee; forgive me my iniquity.
O Lord, Thou hast delivered my soul from the grave.
O ye righteous, sing unto the Lord.
For His anger is but for a moment.
And I, in my joy, said, "I shall not be moved forever."
O Lord, grant me strength for my life according to Thy will.
O Lord, I have cried unto Thee.
What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit?
O Lord, hear me; forgive me, I beseech Thee.
Thou hast turned back my captivity; Thou hast filled my mouth with joy.
That my glory may sing praise unto Thee, and that I be not put to shame.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Saul, to be sung by the chief musician.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘለዓለምም አልፈር፤
ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ፈጥነህም አድነኝ፤
ኀይሌና መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና
አቤቱ፥ አንተ ረዳቴ ነህና
በእጅህ ነፍሴን አደራ እሰጣለሁ፤
ከንቱን ነገር የሚጠብቀውን ሁሉ ሁልጊዜ ጠላህ፤
በትድግናህ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ሐሴትም አደርጋለሁ።
በጠላቴ እጅ አልዘጋኸኝም፥
ተቸግሬአለሁና አቤቱ ይቅር በለኝ፥
ሕይወቴ በመከራ አልቋልና፥
I have been pursued by all my adversaries,
As a dead man, my heart is troubled,
For I have heard the voice of those who reproach me round about;
O Lord, I put my trust in Thee;
My lot is in Thy hand;
Let Thy face shine upon Thy servant;
O Lord, I have called upon Thee, and I will not be forsaken;
In pride and in lamentation
O Lord, according to the multitude of Thy mercies
In Thy presence, Thou wilt silence the strife of men.
In the multitude of my affliction, His mercy was revealed upon me.
I had said, "I am cast away from before Your eyes."
O all you righteous, love the Lord;
All you who trust in the Lord,

sections.title: The Psalm of David.

verses.text: ኀጢአታቸው የተተወላቸው፥
እግዚአብሔር በደሉን የማይቈጥርበት
ሁልጊዜ ከመጮኼ የተነሣ
በቀንና በሌሊት እጅህ ከብዳብኛለችና፥
ኀጢአቴን ነገርሁ፤
ስለዚህ ጻድቅ ሁሉ በምቹ ጊዜ
አንተ ካገኘችኝ ከዚች መከራዬ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፥
አስተምርሃለሁ፥ በምትሄድባትም በዚች መንገድ አጸናሃለሁ።
ወደ አንተ እንዳይቀርቡ
የኃጥኣን መቅሠፍታቸው ብዙ ነው፤
O ye righteous, rejoice in the Lord; be glad, and shout for joy.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O righteous ones, rejoice in the Lord;
and give thanks to the Lord with a song;
and offer Him a new praise;
for the word of the Lord is truth;
the Lord loves righteousness and justice;
in the word of the Lord, the heavens are firm;
as the waters of the sea are gathered like a heap;
let all the earth fear the Lord;
for He has spoken, and it came to pass;
the Lord will bring back the counsel of the nations.
The counsel of the Lord shall endure forever,
The Lord is a God who shall be unto His people a holy one,
The Lord looked down from heaven,
as He has made His dwelling place prepared,
He alone has fashioned their hearts,
The king is not saved by the multitude of his host,
nor is the horse a vain hope for deliverance;
Behold, the eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear Him;
He shall deliver their souls from death,
Our soul waiteth for the Lord; He is our help and our shield.
Our hearts rejoice in Him,
O Lord, as we have believed in You,

sections.title: When he had fled from Abimelech, he changed his countenance; during the time he went away, it was the psalm of David.

verses.text: I will always give thanks to the Lord.
My soul shall magnify the Lord,
Lift up the Lord high above me,
I sought the Lord, and He answered me,
Draw near to Him, and He shall enlighten you,
This afflicted one cried out, and the Lord heard him,
The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him.
The Lord is good; taste and see;
For those who fear Him, there is no lack.
The rich suffer want and hunger, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.
My children, come, hear me;
Who is the man that desires life?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit;
Depart from evil and do good;
The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous,
To cut off their remembrance from the earth;
The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them;
The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart,
The afflictions of the righteous are many,
But the Lord delivers them out of them all.
The death of sin is evil.
The Lord shall redeem the souls of His servants.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ የሚበድሉኝን በድላቸው፥
ጋሻና ጦር ያዝ፥
ሰይፍህን ምዘዝ፥ የሚከብቡኝንም ክበባቸው
ነፍሴን የሚሹ ሁሉ ይፈሩ ይጐሳቈሉም፤
በነፋስ ፊት እንዳለ ትቢያ ይሁኑ፥
መንገዳቸው ዳጥና ጨለማ ትሁን፥
በከንቱ ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ወጥመዳቸውን ሸሽገውብኛልና፥
ያላወቋት ወጥመድ ትምጣባቸው፥
ነፍሴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይላታል፥
አጥንቶች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይሉሃል፦
የዐመፃ ምስክሮች ተነሡብኝ፥
ስለ በጎ ፋንታ ክፉን መለሱልኝ፥
እኔስ ባሠቃዩኝ ጊዜ ማቅ ለበስሁ፥
ለወዳጆቼና ለወንድሞቼ እንደማደርግ አደረግሁ፤
በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ደስም አላቸው፤
ፈተኑኝ፥ በእኔ ላይም ዘበቱብኝ፥ ሣቁብኝም፤
አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ትፈርድልኛለህ?
አቤቱ፥ በታላቁ ጉባኤ ውስጥ እገዛልሃለሁ፥
በግፍ የሚጠሉኝ በላዬ ደስ አይበላቸው፥
ለእኔስ ሰላምን ይናገሩኛልና፥
They did not lay their mouths upon me;
O Lord, behold, do not be silent;
O Lord, arise, and lift up my plea;
O Lord, my God, according to Your righteousness, judge me;
In their hearts and upon my body, let them not say, "We have prevailed";
Let those who rejoice in my affliction be afraid, let them be ashamed;
Let those who love my righteousness rejoice;
My mouth shall speak of Your righteousness;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, the servant of the Lord, for the chief musician.

verses.text: ኀጢአተኛ ራሱን የሚያስትበትን ነገር ይናገራል፥
በአንደበቱ ሸንግሎአልና፤
የአፉ ቃል ዐመፅና ሽንገላ ነው፤
በመኝታው ዐመፅን ዐሰበ፤
አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ነው፥
ጽድቅህም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ተራሮች ናት፤
አቤቱ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን ታድናለህ።
ከቤትህ ጠል ይረካሉ።
የሕይወት ምንጭ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፤
ምሕረትህን በሚያውቁህ ላይ፥
የትዕቢት እግር አይምጣብኝ፥
ዐመፃን የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ በዚያ ይወድቃሉ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: Do not fret over evildoers,
for they shall soon be cut down like the grass;
Trust in the Lord, and do good;
Delight yourself in the Lord;
Commit your way to the Lord;
and your righteousness shall shine forth like the light.
Serve the Lord with gladness.
Turn away from anger, and forsake wrath;
for evildoers shall be cut off;
and the wicked shall not remain.
But the wicked shall inherit the earth,
The sinner shall observe the righteous,
Yet the Lord shall laugh at him,
The wicked shall draw their sword,
Their sword shall enter into their own heart,
In truth, there is but a little,
For the strength of the wicked shall be broken;
The Lord knows the way of the righteous,
In an evil time, they shall not be afraid;
But the wicked shall perish.
ኀጢአተኛ ይበደራል፥ አይከፍልምም፤
እርሱን የሚባርኩት ምድርን ይወርሳሉና፤
የሰው አካሄዱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይጸናል፥
ቢወድቅም አይደነግጥም፥
ጐለመስሁ፥ አረጅሁም፤
ሁልጊዜ ይራራል፤ ያበድራልም፤
ከክፉ ሽሽ፥ መልካሙንም አድርግ፥
እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅን ይወድዳልና፥
ጻድቃን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥
የጻድቅ አፉ ጥበብን ይማራል፥
የአምላኩ ሕግ በልቡ ውስጥ ነው፥
ኀጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለከተዋል፥
እግዚአብሔር ግን በእጁ አይተወውም፥
እግዚአብሔርን ደጅ ጥናው፥ መንገዱንም ጠብቅ፥
ኀጢአተኛን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ፥
ብመለስ ግን አጣሁት፤
ቅንነትን ጠብቅ፥ ጽድቅንም እይ፤
ዐመፀኞች ግን በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ፤
የጻድቃን መድኀኒታቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤
እግዚአብሔር ይረዳቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋልም፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David for the Sabbath remembrance.

verses.text: O Lord, do not forsake me in Your time of need,
for my desires have overwhelmed me;
before Your wrath, there is no strength in my flesh;
for my sin has risen high above me;
and my bones have been shattered before my weakness, and they are broken;
I am greatly troubled, I am utterly dismayed;
for my soul is in distress;
I am greatly troubled and have been afflicted;
O Lord, all my desires are before You;
let my heart rejoice, and let my strength be renewed.
And my neighbors and my companions have become estranged from me; they have turned their backs upon me.
My soul is in anguish; let it be delivered.
But I am as one who is not heard, like a mute.
Like one who does not hear a man.
O Lord, in Thee do I put my trust;
I have said, "Do not let my adversaries prevail against me."
They have set their eyes upon me to ensnare me.
I will speak of my distress.
My adversaries are alive; they have sought my destruction.
In a good manner, let the evil return upon me.
O Lord, do not forsake me;
O Lord, my God, my Savior, hasten to help me.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician, for Edothah.

verses.text: "I will guard my mouth, lest I sin with my tongue;
I was mute, and I did not open my mouth;
My heart was hot within me;
"O Lord, make me to know my end," I said;
Behold, You have made my days a mere handbreadth;
Every man is but a breath;
And now, who is my hope? Is it not the Lord?
Deliver me from all my transgressions;
I was mute, and I did not open my mouth.
Remove Your stroke from me;
In your action, concerning sin, do not let a man be ensnared.
O Lord, hear my prayer, and let my supplication be accepted.
Before I turn back, may I find rest.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን በትዕግሥት ደጅ ጠናሁት፥
ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ ከረግረግ ጭቃም አወጣኝ፥
አዲስ ምስጋናን በአፌ ጨመረ፥ ይህም የአምላካችን ምስጋናው ነው፤
መታመኛው የእግዚአብሔር ስም የሆነ፥
አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ብዙ ተአምራትህን አደረግህ፥
መሥዋዕትንና ቍርባንን አልወደድሁም፤
በዚያን ጊዜ አልሁ፥ “እነሆ፥ መጣሁ፤
አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ መከርሁ፥
በታላቅ ጉባኤ ጽድቅህን አወራሁ፤
ቅንነትህን በልቤ ውስጥ አልሰወርሁም፥
O Lord, do not turn away Your mercy from me;
For I have found a number of transgressions;
O Lord, deliver me from the hand of the oppressor;
Let those who seek to destroy my soul be afraid;
They call out, "Help, help!"
O Lord, all who seek You,
I am poor and needy;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: It is a righteous thing to consider the poor and the needy;
The Lord shall preserve him, and he shall live;
The Lord shall help him while he is upon the bed of languishing;
I also say, "O Lord, have mercy upon me;
My adversaries speak evil against me;
Let him who speaks vanity be silenced;
All my enemies shall be ashamed;
Cast out the matter of wickedness from me.
Moreover, concerning the man of peace, in whom I have trusted,
Yet, O Lord, have mercy upon me;
Therefore, as you have loved me, I have known you.
But as for me, accept me for my worthiness,
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel.

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician.

verses.text: ዋሊያ ወደ ውኃ ምንጮች እንደሚናፍቅ፥
ነፍሴ ወደ ሕያው አምላኬ ተጠማች፤
ዘወትር፥ “አምላክህ ወዴት ነው?” ይሉኛልና
ይህን ሳስብ ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ፈሰሰች፥
ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ?
ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ታወከች፤
በፍዋፍዋቴህ ድምፅ ቀላይ ቀላይን ትጠራዋለች፤
እግዚአብሔር በቀን ይቅርታውን ያዝዛል፥
እግዚአብሔርን አልሁት፥ “አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ ለምን ረሳኸኝ?
ሁልጊዜ፥ “አምላክህ ወዴት ነው?” ይሉኛልና።
O my soul, why art thou cast down? And why art thou disquieted within me?

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, deliver me,
Thou art my God, and Thou art my strength; why dost Thou sleep?
Send forth Thy light and Thy righteousness;
to the house of the Lord.
O my soul, why art thou cast down? And why art thou disquieted within me?

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician.

verses.text: O Lord, we have heard with our ears,
Thy hand hath destroyed our enemies, and them hast Thou cast away;
They have not prevailed against the land with their sword,
Thou art my God and my King;
In Thee we shall pursue all our adversaries,
I do not trust in my bow,
But Thou hast saved us from those who rise against us,
Always will we glorify the Lord God,
But now, Thou hast forsaken us and made us ashamed,
Turn back our enemies and bring them to our rear.
As sheep, Thou hast given us to be devoured,
Thou hast given Thy people without price,
For our neighbors, a reproach,
For the nations, a taunt,
My disgrace is continually before me,
From the voice of the slanderer and the reviler,
All this hath come upon us,
Our hearts have not turned back,
For we have been cast down in a wicked place,
If it be that we forget the name of our God,
እግዚአብሔር ይህን በተመራመረው ነበር!
ስለ እርሱ ሁልጊዜ ይገድሉናልና፥
አቤቱ፥ ንቃ፤ ለምንስ ትተኛለህ?
ለምንስ ፊትህን ከእኛ ትመልሳለህ?
ነፍሳችን በመሬት ላይ ተጐሳቍላለችና፥
አቤቱ፥ ተነሥና ርዳን፥

sections.title: A Psalm of Love, for the Chief Musician, for the sons of Korah, a teaching.

verses.text: ልቤ መልካም ነገርን ተናገረ፥
ውበቱ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ ያምራል፤
ኀያል ሆይ፥ በደም ግባትህና በውበትህ፥
ስለ ቅንነትና ስለ የዋህነት ስለ ጽድቅም
ኀያል ሆይ፥ ፍላጻዎችህ የተሳሉ ናቸው፥
አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ ለዘለዓለም ነው፤
ጽድቅን ወደድህ፥ ዐመፃንም ጠላህ፤
ከርቤና ሽቱ ዝባድም በልብሶችህ ናቸው።
የንግሥት ሴቶች ልጆች ለክብርህ ናቸው፤
ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስሚ እዪ፥ ጆሮሽንም አዘንብዪ፤
Thy beauty, O queen, hath captivated us,
The daughters of Tyre shall bring gifts; the rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.
For the daughter of the king is all glorious within;
Her clothing is of wrought gold; she shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework.
With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought;
They shall enter into the king's palace.
Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, concerning the mystery, for the chief musician.

verses.text: Our God is our refuge and our strength;
Therefore, if the earth should tremble,
their voices shall cry out and they shall be broken;
A river and a stream shall bring joy to the city of God;
Do not be shaken, for the Lord is in the midst of her;
The nations were in an uproar, and the kingdoms returned;
The Lord of hosts is with us;
the work of the Lord,
He shall make war cease to the ends of the earth;
Be still, and know that I am God.
የሠራዊት ጌታ ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician.

verses.text: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እጆቻችሁን አጨብጭቡ፥
እግዚአብሔር ልዑል፥ ግሩምም ነውና፥
አሕዛብን ከእኛ በታች፥
ለርስቱ እኛን መረጠን፥
እግዚአብሔር በእልልታ፥
ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችን ዘምሩ፤
እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ሁሉ ንጉሥ ነውና፤
እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ላይ ነገሠ፤
የአሕዛብ አለቆች ከአብርሃም አምላክ ጋር ተሰበሰቡ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise by the Sons of Korah, for the Second Sabbath.

verses.text: The Lord is great;
He who commands joy for all the earth,
In the time of its acceptance, the Lord shall know its blessing.
Behold, the kings of the earth are gathered together in unity.
They beheld this and were troubled, they were afraid, and they trembled.
They were seized with trembling, as a woman in labor.
By the mighty wind, You shall scatter the ships of Tarshish.
As we have seen, so have we looked,
O God, accept our supplication among the nations.
O God, as is Your name.
O Lord, for Thy judgment, the mountains of Zion shall rejoice in Thee,
Glorify Zion, and exalt her.
In her strength, let your hearts be lifted;
For this is our God, both for the world and for all eternity.

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician.

verses.text: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤
የሰው ልጆች ባለጠጎችና ድሆች፥ በየሀገራችሁ በአንድነት።
አፌ ጥበብን ይናገራል፥
በጆሮዬ ምሳሌ አደምጣለሁ፥
ከክፉ ቀን ለምን እፈራለሁ?
በኀይላቸው የሚታመኑ፥
ወንድም ወንድሙን አያድንም፥ ሰውም አያድንም፤
የነፍሱንም ዋጋ ለውጥ፥
በዓለም የደከመ ለዘለዓለም ይድናል፥
ጠቢባንን ሲሞቱ ባየሃቸው ጊዜ፥
Their graves are their everlasting abode,
Yet man, while he is honored, is not known;
When they are loved by their mouths, she is the one who leads them in their ways;
Like sheep, death shall keep them in Sheol;
But at the time that they are taken,
In the time of their abundance, when the glory of their house increases, let not man be afraid;
At the time of death, he shall take nothing with him;
While he is alive, his body rejoices in him;
And he shall descend to the world of his fathers;
Yet man, when he is honored, is not known.

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph.

verses.text: The Lord God of hosts hath spoken, and He hath called unto the earth;
From the beauty of His glory and from Zion,
The Lord shall come forth in brightness.
The heavens that are above,
As the law requireth the offerings presented,
The heavens shall declare His righteousness,
O My people, listen that I may speak unto thee;
Concerning thy offerings, I shall not be silent;
From thy house, O My beloved,
All the beasts of the field,
I know all the hosts of heaven,
Yet you do not know me,
I do not eat the flesh of the unclean,
Offer unto the Lord the sacrifices of thanksgiving,
In the day of your trouble, you shall call upon me,
But the wicked, the Lord says:
You have pursued my righteousness,
When you see the thief, you join with him,
Your mouth has multiplied transgressions,
You sit and slander your brother.
ይህን አድርገህ ዝም አልሁህ፤
እግዚአብሔርን የምትረሱ እናንተ፥ ይህን አስተውሉ፤
የከበረች መሥዋዕት ታከብረኛለች፥

sections.title: To the chief musician, when he came to Beersheba, after the prophet Nathan had come unto him, a psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, according to the measure of Thy mercy, have mercy upon me;
Deliver me from all my transgressions;
For I know my transgressions;
Against Thee alone have I sinned;
Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity;
Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts;
Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean;
Make me to hear joy and gladness;
Hide Thy face from my sins;
O Lord, create in me a clean heart.
Do not turn me away from Your presence,
Grant me joy and Your salvation,
Teach the way to the wicked,
O Lord, God of my Savior,
O Lord, open my lips,
I was once in Your favor when You accepted my offerings;
The offerings of the Lord are a broken spirit,
O Lord, in Your goodness restore Zion;
The offerings of the righteous,

sections.title: To the chief musician, a psalm of David, when he fled from Saul to Abimelech: David came to Abimelech's house, and thus he spoke in that time, the psalm of David.

verses.text: O mighty one, why dost thou rage against the wicked?
Thy heart pondereth iniquity;
Rather than good, thou choosest wickedness;
All that is pleasing to thee, thou dost embrace.
Therefore, the Lord hath condemned thee for eternity;
The righteous shall not be forsaken; they shall fear not;
"He who hath not aided the Lord,
I am as a green olive tree in the house of the Lord;
Thou hast done good unto me, and for eternity I give thanks unto thee;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician, upon Mahalath.

verses.text: The heart says: "There is no God," thus it speaks.
Let not the wise man say that he seeks the Lord.
All are gathered together in unity, in peace.
As my people eat bread, so do they consume.
The Lord sustains the bones of the righteous.
Who shall give the Savior from Zion to Israel?

sections.title: To the chief musician, with stringed instruments, a psalm of David, when he fled from Saul. Behold, David is greatly distressed among us, thus saith the people in their discourse, this is the psalm of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ በስምህ አድነኝ፥
አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥
ባዕዳን በእኔ ላይ ቆመዋልና፥
እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፥
ክፋትን ወደ ጠላቶች ይመልሳታል፤
ከፈቃዴ የተነሣ እሠዋልሃለሁ፤
ከመከራ ሁሉ አድኖኛልና፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, upon the instruments of stringed music.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጠኝ፥
ተመልከተኝ፥ ስማኝም፤
ከጠላት ድምፅ፥ ከኀጢአተኛም ማሠቃየት የተነሣ፥
ልቤ በላዬ ደነገጠብኝ፥
ፍርሃትና እንቅጥቅጥ ያዙኝ፥
በርሬ ዐርፍ ዘንድ እንደ ርግብ ክንፍን ማን በሰጠኝ አልሁ፥
እነሆ፥ ኮብልዬ በራቅሁ፥ በምድረ በዳም በኖርሁ፤
እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከሆነው ከነፍሴ መቅበዝበዝ የሚያድነኝን ተስፋ አደርገዋለሁ።
አቤቱ፥ ዐመፃንና ጠብን በከተማ ውስጥ አይችአለሁና
በቀንና በሌሊት በቅጥርዋ ይከብቡአታል፤
The serpent shall not depart from its dwelling.
Though an enemy may assail me, I was in your protection;
You, O man, were as I am;
You were united with me in the light;
Let death come upon them;
But I cried out to the Lord,
In the evening and in the morning, I shall speak;
For those who are with me shall be multiplied;
They have no wealth, and they do not fear the Lord;
To bring forth the covenant, he stretched forth his hand; they kept the covenant.
ከፊቱም ቍጣ የተነሣ ተለያዩ፥ ልቡም ቀረበ፤
ትካዜህን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጣል፥
አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ ሞት ጕድጓድ አውርዳቸው፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is.

verses.text: O Lord, for man hath oppressed me, have mercy upon me;
All the day long have mine adversaries pressed upon me;
But I, O Lord, do trust in Thee.
I will honor the word of the Lord;
Always shall they cry out against me;
They will conspire against me, they will plot against me;
In any manner, they shall not prevail against me;
My God, I will declare my life unto Thee;
At the time I call upon Thee, let mine adversaries turn back;
I will honor the word of the Lord.
በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፥ አልፈራም፥ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?
አቤቱ፥ የምስጋና ስእለት የምሰጥህ ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፤
ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ ዐይኖቼን ከዕንባ፥ እግሮቼንም ከድጥ አድነሃልና፥

sections.title: Do not cast away the leader of the singers. This is the song of David, when he fled from Saul and went to dwell in the wilderness.

verses.text: Forgive me, O Lord, forgive me.
To the Most High God,
Send down from heaven and deliver me,
Save my soul from among the lions.
The Lord is high above the heavens,
Prepare a path for my feet,
My heart is steadfast, O Lord, my heart is steadfast.
Let my glory arise, let it arise in the morning and at the evening;
O Lord, I give thanks unto Thee among the nations,
For Thy mercy reaches unto the heavens, and Thy truth unto the clouds.
The Lord is high above the heavens; He is exalted.

sections.title: Do not destroy the leader of the singers. A psalm of David.

verses.text: If you speak of righteousness in truth,
In your hearts, you commit iniquity upon the earth,
Let the wicked depart from the womb;
Their anger is as the sting of a serpent,
When the wise one speaks, the words of the fool are not heard.
The Lord shall consume their wrath within their mouths;
As water is poured out, they shall be scattered;
As the sound of a whisper shall they not be heard;
Your sins shall be like a thorn, unknown in the thicket;
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the wicked fall.
And man said, "Truly, there is a fruit for the righteous;"

sections.title: Do not destroy the leader of the singers. When Saul sent to slay him, he sent to keep his house. The song of David.

verses.text: O my God, deliver me from my enemies;
Protect me from those who rise against me;
Behold, my soul is in distress;
I am prepared, for I have done no wrong;
Thou art, O Lord, the God of the mighty, the King of Israel;
Let them return at evening, and howl like dogs;
Behold, they speak with their mouths;
But Thou, O Lord, dost hear them and dost mock them;
I pour out my strength unto Thee;
May the mercy of my God come upon me.
Do not oppress them, lest they forsake Your law;
Because of their mouths, sin is upon them, and by their pride, they shall be judged.
They shall not be shaken by the coming of destruction;
At night they shall return, like dogs they shall growl;
They shall gather to seek food.
But I will rest in Your strength;
You are my helper, and to You, my God, I will sing praises.

sections.title: To the chief musician, when the Syrians of Zobah came and fought against him, and when Joab returned and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand men. For teaching, a psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, Thou hast led me and hast not forsaken me;
Thou hast not turned away from the earth, nor hast Thou abandoned it;
Thou hast shown Thy people great wonders;
Thou hast given a sign unto those who fear Thee;
And Thy friends, that they may be delivered.
The Lord spoke in His sanctuary;
"Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine;
Ephraim also is the strength of My head;
Who shall ascend to the mountain of the Lord, or who shall stand in His holy place?
O Lord, art Thou not the One who has led us?
In our affliction, grant us deliverance,
In the strength of the Lord, we shall act;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, upon the instruments of stringed music.

verses.text: O my God, hear my supplication,
When my heart is overwhelmed, I cry out to You from the depths of the earth;
Before my enemies, You are a stronghold;
In Your sanctuary, I shall dwell forever;
O my God, You have heard my prayer;
You shall add days to the king beyond the days of his life;
Before the Lord, he shall dwell forever;
Likewise, for Your name, I shall sing praises forever.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, concerning Edom, for the chief musician.

verses.text: Is my soul not purchased by the Lord?
For He is my God and my Redeemer;
Until when will you stand against man?
Yet they shall be ashamed to seek my glory;
But truly, my soul shall be purchased by the Lord;
For He is my God and my Redeemer;
My Redeemer is in the Lord;
O congregation of the nations, trust in Him;
Yet all the children of men are vanity;
Do not place your hope in oppression.
The Lord spoke once,
O Lord, Thine is the power;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Edom.

verses.text: O my God, O my God, to Thee do I cry for help;
Let Thy power and Thy glory be known;
For Thy mercy is better than life;
Thus will I praise Thee while I live;
My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness;
In my bed I remember Thee;
For Thou hast been my help;
My soul follows hard after Thee;
But they seek my soul to destroy it;
Let them fall by the sword; let them be a portion for foxes.
But the king shall rejoice in the Lord;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: O Lord, hear my prayer, which I have made unto Thee.
From the wicked, deliver me.
As a serpent, they have sharpened their tongues.
They have prepared a net to ensnare the innocent.
They have concealed evil against themselves.
They seek to destroy.
And the Lord shall say, "Behold, I am high."
They have fallen upon their own heads.
Every man is afraid.
The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord; in Him shall they trust.

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise, of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: O Lord, it is fitting for Thee to receive praise in Zion,
And hear the prayer of every man that cometh unto Thee.
The matter of the oppressed Thou dost deliver;
Thou hast chosen the one whom Thou dost accept to be holy for the performance of Thy service;
Thy sanctuary is holy, and it is wondrous in righteousness.
By Thy power, Thou dost still the mountains;
He is the one who knows the fish of the sea.
The peoples that arise from Thy wonders shall be in awe;
Thou hast visited the earth and satisfied it;
Thou dost provide for the great abundance.
Blessed art Thou, O Lord, for the year of Thy mercy.
The mountains of the wilderness shall rejoice,
And the pastures of the sheep shall be clothed with joy.

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise for the Chief Musician, a Song of Ascents.

verses.text: በምድር ያላቸሁ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥
ለስሙም ዘምሩ፥ ለክብሩም ምስጋናን ስጡ።
እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ በሉት፥ “ሥራህ ግሩም ነው፤
ምድር ሁላ ለአንተ ትሰግዳለች፥
የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ታዩ ዘንድ ኑ።
ባሕርን የብስ አደረጋት፥
በኀይሉ ለዘለዓለም ይገዛል፤
አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ አምላካችንን አመስግኑ፥
ነፍሴን በሕይወት ያኖራታል፥
አቤቱ፥ ፈትነኸናልና፥
And to the place of refuge, Thou hast brought us,
Upon ourselves, let not man oppress us;
I shall take my leave and enter into Thy house;
In the time of my affliction, I have spoken with my mouth;
With the wicked and the deceitful;
All ye who fear the Lord, come, hearken unto me;
With my mouth, I cried out unto Him;
Though my heart may be filled with sin,
Therefore, O Lord, hear me;
My prayer has not been disregarded.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician, upon the instruments of stringed music.

verses.text: The Lord bless us and keep us,
Your way upon the earth,
O Lord, the nations give You thanks,
For to the nations, in righteousness, You shall judge them.
O Lord, the nations give You thanks.
The earth has yielded its fruit;
The Lord blesses us.

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise, of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር ይነሣ፥ ጠላቶቹም ይበተኑ፥
ጢስ እንደሚበንን እንዲሁ ይብነኑ፤
ጻድቃን ግን ደስ ይበላቸው፥
እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ለስሙም ዘምሩ፤
እግዚአብሔር በቅዱስ ቦታው
እግዚአብሔር ብቸኞችን በቤቱ ያሳድራቸዋል፥
አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብህ ፊት በወጣህ ጊዜ፥
ከሲና አምላክ ፊት፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ፊት
አቤቱ፥ በፈቃድህ ዝናብን ለርስትህ ለየህ፥
እንስሶችህ በውስጡ ያድራሉ፤
For those who are mighty shall be exalted.
To the powerful king, to his beloved;
Among the saints, when you are gathered,
The heavenly King, when He commands from above,
The mountain of the Lord is a mountain that cannot be moved;
Why do the mountains of the day rise?
Many thousands of the Lord's hosts are joyful.
You have ascended to heaven, having adorned yourself with glory.
The Lord God is blessed;
Our God is a God of salvation.
Nevertheless, the Lord shall break the head of His enemies,
The Lord said thus: "I will go forth, and I shall return."
Thy feet shall be washed in blood,
O Lord, Thy way is made manifest.
The rulers have arrived, and the singers are with them.
In the assembly, let us praise the Lord,
And the young man Benjamin is there in his strength.
O Lord, by Thy power, I shall sing;
In Jerusalem, in Thy holy temple,
Within the confines of Thy sanctuary are the creatures.
Let the messengers come forth from Egypt;
O ye kings of the earth, give glory unto the Lord God;
In the east, sing unto the Lord who ascended to the heavens;
Bring forth unto the Lord your praise;
The Lord is wondrous among His saints;

sections.title: A Psalm of David for the Chief Musician, upon the instruments of the heavens.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ውኃ እስከ ነፍሴ ደርሶብኛልና አድነኝ።
በጥልቅ ረግረግ ጠለቅሁ ኀይልም የለኝም፤
በጩኸት ደከምሁ፥ ጉሮሮዬም ሻከረ፤
በከንቱ የሚጠሉኝ ከራሴ ጠጉር በዙ፤
አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስንፍናዬን ታውቃለህ፥
አቤቱ፥ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ የሚሹህ በእኔ አይፈሩ፤
ስለ አንተ ስድብን ታግሻለሁና፥
ለወንድሞቼ እንደ ባዕድ፥
የቤትህ ቅንዓት በልቶኛልና፥
ሰውነቴን በጾም አደከምኋት፥
I have become a refuge for the oppressed.
Those who sit at the gate shall play before me;
I am before the Lord in my prayer.
Deliver me from the snares of the wicked, lest they ensnare me.
The flood of water shall not overwhelm me, nor shall the deep swallow me.
O Lord, Your mercy is good; hear me.
Do not turn away from Your servant.
Look upon my soul and redeem it.
You are my strength, my refuge,
My body is afflicted with weakness and distress.
They have added death within the darkness,
Their majesty is before them.
Let their eyes be blinded that they may not see,
Pour forth Your wrath upon them.
Let their city be a desolation,
For they have followed after that which You have cursed,
Add sin upon their sin,
Let them be consumed from the book of the living,
I am poor and needy;
I will give thanks to the name of the Lord in song.
Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
The poor shall eat and be satisfied;
for the Lord hath heard the cry of the poor.
The heavens and the earth, and the sea,
for the Lord hath built up Zion;
the seed of thy servants shall dwell therein.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician, to bring to remembrance.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለማዳን ተመልከት፤
ነፍሴን የሚሹአት ይፈሩ፥ ይጐስቍሉም፥
እሰይ! እሰይ! የሚሉኝ አፍረው ወዲያው ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ።
አቤቱ፥ የሚሹህ ሁሉ በአንተ ሐሤት ያድርጉ፥ ደስም ይበላቸው፤
እኔ ድሃና ምስኪን ነኝ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይረዳኛል፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David concerning the children of Amminadab, for I have been instructed beforehand.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘለዓለም አላፍርም።
በጽድቅህ አስጥለኝ፥ ታደገኝም፤
በጠንካራ ቦታ ታድነኝ ዘንድ
አምላኬ ከኃጥኣን እጅ፥
አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፥
በእናቴ ማኅፀን በአንተ ጸናሁ፥
ለብዙዎች እንደ ጥንግ ሆንሁ፤
አፌን በምስጋና ምላ
በእርጅናዬ ዘመን አትጣለኝ፥
ጠላቶቼ በእኔ ላይ ተናግረዋልና፥
“እግዚአብሔር ትቶታል፤
አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤
ነፍሴን የሚያጣሏት ይፈሩ፥ ይዋረዱም፥
እኔ ግን አቤቱ ሁልጊዜ ተስፋ አደርግሃለሁ፥
አፌ ጽድቅህን፥ ሁልጊዜም ማዳንህን ይናገራል።
በእግዚአብሔር ኀይል እገባለሁ፤
አምላኬ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ አስተማርኸኝ፤
አምላኬ ሆይ እስክሸመግልም ድረስ፥
አቤቱ፥ እስከ አርያም ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አደረግህ፤
ብዙ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አሳይተኸኛልና፥
ጽድቅህንም አበዛኸው።
እኔም በመዝሙር መሣሪያ ስለ እውነትህ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤
ዝማሬን ባቀረብሁልህ ጊዜ ከንፈሮቼን ደስ ይላቸዋል፥
ክፉን ለእኔ የሚሹ ባፈሩና በተነወሩ ጊዜ፥

sections.title: Concerning Solomon.

verses.text: O Lord, grant Thy judgment unto the king,
Thy people in righteousness,
Let the mountains and the hills receive the peace of Thy people.
For the poor, Thy people shall be judged in righteousness,
In every season where the sun doth shine,
As the dew upon the grass,
In his time, righteousness shall flourish,
From sea to sea,
And before Him, Ethiopia shall bow down,
The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring gifts.
All the kings of the earth shall bow down before Him,
The hand that supports the poor,
Shall be a refuge for the needy and the destitute,
He shall deliver their souls from oppression and from violence;
He shall live, and they shall offer Him gold from Arabia;
Upon the mountains shall be a place of refuge for all the earth;
His name is blessed forever and ever,
He alone performs wonders,
May the name of the Benefactor be blessed for the world and for all eternity.

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph.

verses.text: ልባቸው ለቀና ለእስራኤል እግዚአብሔር እጅግ ቸር ነው።
እኔ ግን እግሮች ሊሰናከሉ፥
የዐመፀኞችን ሰላም አይቼ
ለሞታቸው እረፍት የለውምና፤
በድካምም ጠላት አልሆኑም።
ስለዚህም ትዕቢት ያዛቸው፤
መቅን ከቅልጥም እንደሚወጣ ኀጢአታቸው ይወጣል።
ዐስበው ከንቱ ነገርን ተናገሩ።
አፋቸውንም በሰማይ አኖሩ፥
ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤
"How shall the Lord know?"
"Behold, these mighty ones rejoice in them;"
"Thus I have said, 'In truth, have I cleansed my heart in vain?'"
"Always have I been afflicted,"
"As I speak thus, let it be;"
"Know that I have received you,"
"Let it be known their judgment;"
"Yet concerning their transgressions, you have not regarded them,"
"How have they become for destruction! They are utterly consumed,"
"As one awakens from sleep,"
ልቤ ነድዶአል፥ ኵላሊቴም ቀልጦአልና፤
እኔ የተናቅሁ ነኝ፥ አላወቅሁምም፥
እኔ ግን ዘወትር ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥
በአንተ ምክር መራኸኝ፤
በሰማይ ያለኝ ምንድን ነው?
የመድኀኒቴ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልቤና ሥጋዬ አለቀ፤
እነሆ፥ ከአንተ የሚርቁ ይጠፋሉና፤
ለእኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን መከተል ይሻለኛል፤

sections.title: The Teaching of Asaph.

verses.text: O Lord, why hast Thou forsaken us forever?
Thou hast created Thy congregation from the beginning,
The enemy hath spread like a flood over Thy saints,
Thy adversaries have taken their stand amidst Thy feast;
Even as the upper way,
So have they broken in upon the sanctuary and the dwelling place.
They have set Thy sanctuary on fire;
They have become one, saying in their hearts, each according to their people:
We know not the sign, for from henceforth there shall be no prophet;
O Lord, how long shall the enemy reproach?
አቤቱ፥ እጅህን ፈጽመህ ለምን ትመልሳለህ?
እግዚአብሔር ግን ከዓለም አስቀድሞ ንጉሥ ነው፥
አንተ ባሕርን በኀይልህ አጸናሃት፤
አንተም የዘንዶውን ራሶች ቀጠቀጥህ፤
አንተ ፈሳሾቹንና ምንጮቹን ሰነጠቅህ።
ቀኑ የአንተ ነው፥ ሌሊቱም የአንተ ነው፤
አንተ የምድር ዳርቻዎችን ሁሉ ሠራህ፤
ይህን ፍጥረትህን ዐስብ።
የምትገዛልህን ነፍስ ለአራዊት አትስጣት፤
ወደ ኪዳንህም ተመልከት፥
ችግረኛ አፍሮ አይመለስ፤
አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፥ በቀሌንም ተበቀል፤
የባሪያዎችህን ቃል አትርሳ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise, for the Chief Musician, a Song of Asaph.

verses.text: O Lord, I give thanks unto Thee;
When I find the time, I shall earnestly seek Thee.
Let all that dwell upon the earth rejoice;
I shall not forsake the wicked, saying, "Do not be proud."
Do not forget your days until the end;
For there is no honor from the east or from the west, nor from the wilderness;
For the Lord is a refuge;
The cup is in the hand of the Lord;
But I, indeed, shall rejoice forever;
I shall gather all the days of the wicked.

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph, concerning the Assyrians, for the chief musician, to be sung in the gardens.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ ታወቀ፥
በሀገሩም በሰላም ኖረ፥ ማደሪያውም በጽዮን ነው፤
በዚያም የቀስትን ኀይል፥
አንተ በዘለዓለም ተራሮች ሆነህ በድንቅ ታበራለህ።
ልበ ሰነፎች ሁሉ ደነገጡ፥
የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከተግሣጽህ የተነሣ
አንተ ግን፥ ግሩም ነህ፤
ፍርድን ከሰማይ ታሰማለህ።
ልበ የዋሃንን ሁሉ ያድን ዘንድ፥
ሰው በፈቃዱ ያመሰግንሃልና፥
ለአምላካችን ለአግዚአብሔር ስእለትን ሰጡ፤
የአለቆችን ነፍስ ያወጣል፤

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph, concerning Edom, for the chief musician.

verses.text: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥
በመከራዬ ቀን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት፤
እግዚአብሔርን ዐሰብሁት፥ ደስ አለኝም፤
ደነገጥሁ አልተናገርሁምም።
የድሮውን ዘመን ዐሰብሁ፤
በሌሊት ከልቤ ጋር ተጫወትሁ፥
እግዚአብሔር ለዘለዓለም በውኑ ይጥላልን?
ለዘለዓለምስ ምሕረቱን ለልጅ ልጅ ይቈርጣልን?
እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታን ይረሳልን?
እነሆ፥ ዛሬ ጀመርሁ አልሁ፥
I have proclaimed the works of the Lord;
In all your ways, I shall speak of you,
O Lord, your way is within the sanctuary;
You alone are God, who performs wonders;
The children of Jacob and Joseph,
O Lord, they are your witnesses;
The clouds gave forth their voice;
The sound of your thunder was in the heavens;
Your way is in the sea,
in the hand of Moses and Aaron.

sections.title: The Teaching of Asaph.

verses.text: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ሕጌን አድምጡ፥
አፌን በምሳሌ እከፍታለሁ፤
የሰማነውንና ያየነውን፥
የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ተናገሩ፥
ለያዕቆብ ያቆመውን ምስክር፥
የሚመጣ ትውልድ የሚወለዱም ልጆች ያውቁ ዘንድ፥
ተስፋቸውን በእግዚአብሔር እንዲያደርጉ፥
እንደ አባቶቻቸው እንዳይሆኑ፥
የኤፍሬም ልጆች ቀስታቸውን ገትረው ይወጉ ነበር።
የእግዚአብሔርን ኪዳን አልጠበቁምና፥
He showed them His wonders and His signs,
in the land of Egypt and in the wilderness of Tanis.
He lifted the sea and caused them to pass through;
by day He led them with a cloud,
and He made the wilderness tremble.
And He gathered the waters as in a heap.
Yet they again provoked Him to anger,
seeking food for their souls.
They spoke thus against God, saying:
"Can God prepare a table in the wilderness? Can He provide water?"
እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤
በእግዚአብሔር አላመኑምና፥
ደመናውንም ከላይ አዘዘ፥
ይበሉም ዘንድ መናን አዘነበላቸው፥
የመላእክትንም እንጀራ የሰው ልጆች በሉ።
ከሰማይ ዐዜባዊ ነፋስን አስነሣ፥
ሥጋን እንደ አፈር፥
በሰፈራቸው መካከል፥
በሉ፥ እጅግም ጠገቡ፤
ከወደዱትም አላሳጣቸውም፤
የእግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍት በላያቸው መጣ፥
ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር እንደ ገና እርሱን በደሉ፥
ቀኖቻቸውም በከንቱ አለቁ፥
በገደላቸውም ጊዜ ወዲያው ፈለጉት፤
ረዳታቸውም እግዚአብሔር፥
በአፋቸው ብቻ ወደዱት፤
ልባቸውም ከእርሱ ጋር አልቀናም፥
እርሱ ግን መሐሪ ነው፥
ሥጋም እንደ ሆኑ ዐሰበ።
በምድረ በዳ ምን ያህል አስቈጡት፥
They returned, and they tested the Lord.
Yet they did not remember His hand,
the wonders He performed in Egypt,
and He turned their rivers into blood.
He sent swarms of flies upon them, and they were troubled;
He gave their harvest to the locusts,
and their labor to the hail.
He gave their cattle to the hail,
and He sent upon them the fierceness of His wrath.
He made a way for His anger.
በኵሮቻቸውንም ሁሉ በግብፅ ምድር፥
ሕዝቡን ግን እንደ በጎች አሰማራቸው፥
በተስፋም መራቸው አልፈሩምም፥
ወደ መቅደሱም ተራራ ወሰዳቸው፥
ከፊታቸውም አሕዛብን አባረረ፥
ነገር ግን ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን ፈተኑት፥
ተመለሱም፥ እንደ አባቶቻቸውም ከዱ፤
በኮረብቶቻቸውም አስቈጡት፥
እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ።
የሴሎምንም ድንኳን ተዋት፥
He raised their strength for the battle,
And He caused their people to be engulfed in war,
He consumed their hosts with fire,
And their priests fell by the sword,
And the Lord arose as one who awakens from sleep,
And He struck down their enemies behind them;
He also destroyed the dwelling of Joseph,
But He chose the tribe of Judah,
He made His sanctuary like the heights,
And He chose His servant David.
ከሚያጠቡ በጎችም በኋላ፥
በልቡ ቅንነት ጠበቃቸው፥

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ወደ ርስትህ ገቡ፤
የባሪያዎችህንም በድኖች ለሰማይ ወፎች መብል አደረጉ፥
ደማቸውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ውኃ አፈሰሱ፥
ለጎረቤቶቻችንም ስድብ ሆንን፥
አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘለዓለም ትቈጣለህ?
በማያውቁህም አሕዛብ ላይ
ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥
የቀደመውን በደላችንን አታስብብን፥
አምላካችንና መድኀኒታችን ሆይ፥ ርዳን፥
አሕዛብ፥ “አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው?” እንዳይሉን፥
The cry of the oppressed shall come before Thee;
O Lord, the oppression of those who have been wronged,
But we, Thy people, are the sheep of Thy pasture;

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph, concerning the Assyrians, for the chief musician, to be sung.

verses.text: Thou dost lead Joseph as a flock,
before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh.
O God of hosts, restore us,
O God of hosts, look upon us,
Thou dost feed us with the bread of our tears,
Thou hast made us a strife unto our neighbors,
O God of hosts, restore us,
Thou hast brought forth a vine out of Egypt;
Thou didst cast out the nations and planted it.
It sent forth its boughs unto the sea.
ቅርንጫፎችዋንም እስከ ባሕር፥
አጥርዋን ለምን አፈረስህ?
የበረሃ እርያ አረከሳት፥
የኀያላን አምላክ ሆይ፥ እባክህ ተመለስ፤
በሰው ልጅ ለአንተ ያጸናኻትን
በእሳት ተቃጥላለች፥ ተነቅላማለች
ለአንተ ባጸናኸው በሰው ልጅ ላይ፥
ከአንተም አንራቅ፤
የኀያላን አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph, for the Chief Musician, in Washington.

verses.text: Rejoice in the Lord your God, for He shall bring you joy.
Sing the song and give praise from the trumpet.
On the day of your remembrance, on the day of our feast,
for it is the law for Israel.
And when he went into the land of Egypt, he stood as a witness for Joseph.
He returned from their place of refuge.
In your time of trouble, you called upon me, and I answered you.
O my people, listen to me; I will speak to you.
If you do not hear me, you shall not be a God of thunder.
I brought you out from the land of Egypt.
My people, however, did not listen to My voice,
According to their deeds, I sent them,
If My people had listened to My voice,
I would have quickly subdued their adversaries,
The enemies of the Lord would have been humbled,
They would have eaten the finest of wheat,

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph.

verses.text: The Lord stood in the assembly of the gods,
How long will you judge unjustly?
Defend the poor and the needy;
Deliver the weak and the destitute;
They do not know, nor do they understand;
I, however, say, "You are gods,
but you shall die like men;
Arise, O God, judge the earth;

sections.title: A Psalm of Asaph, a song of praise.

verses.text: O Lord, who is like unto Thee?
Behold, Thy adversaries have raised their voices,
They have conspired against Thy people with counsel,
"Come, let us cut them off from being a nation,
For they have united together and strengthened themselves;"
The descendants of Edom, and the Ishmaelites,
Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek,
Assyria also hath joined with them,
As the Midianites and as Sisera,
As the men of Endor, let them be destroyed.
Their leaders are like the hare and like the wolf,
We shall inherit the sanctuary of the Lord, they say.
O my God, like a whirlwind,
Fire consumes the forest,
Thus in Your anger, bring them to ruin,
Fill their faces with shame,
Let them fear, and let them be confounded forever;
Your name, O Lord, is as it is.

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician, upon the instruments of Gath.

verses.text: የኀያላን አምላክ ሆይ፥
አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴ አደባባዮችህን በመውደድ ደስ አላት፤
ወፍ ለእርስዋ ቤትን አገኘች፥
በቤትህ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ብፁዓን ናቸው፤
አቤቱ፥ ርዳታው ከአንተ ዘንድ የሆነለት፥
በልቅሶ ሸለቆ ውስጥ በወሰንኻቸው ስፍራ
ከኀይል ወደ ኀይልም ይሄዳል፥
የኀያላን አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፤
አቤቱ፥ መታመኔን እይልኝ፥
ከአእላፍ ይልቅ በአደባባዮችህ አንዲት ቀን ትሻላለች፤
The Lord God loves righteousness and truth;
O Lord, God of the mighty, behold,

sections.title: A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the chief musician.

verses.text: O Lord, forgive Thy land.
Forgive Thy people their transgressions;
And remove all Thy wrath.
Our God and our Savior, have mercy upon us;
Do not be angry with us forever;
Thou art our God, O Lord, return unto us, and save us;
O Lord, show us Thy mercy;
The Lord my God, I shall heed that which He speaks to me;
Yet honor may dwell in our land;
Let mercy and truth meet together;
Truth has fallen from the earth,
And the Lord shall bestow His mercy,
Righteousness shall walk before Him,

sections.title: A Prayer of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል ስማኝም፥
እኔ የዋህ ነኝና ነፍሴን ጠብቃት፤
አቤቱ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁና ይቅር በለኝ።
የባሪያህን ነፍስ ደስ አሰኛት፥
አቤቱ፥ አንተ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነህና፥
አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥
ትሰማኛለህና በመከራዬ ቀን ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ።
አቤቱ፥ ከአማልክት የሚመስልህ የለም፥
የፈጠርሃቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይምጡ፥
አቤቱ፥ ድንቅን የምታደርግ አንተ ታላቅ ነህና፥
አቤቱ መንገድህን ምራኝ፥
አቤቱ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ።
ምሕረትህ በእኔ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥
አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ዐመፅኞች በእኔ ላይ ተነሥተዋል፥
አቤቱ፥ አንተ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነህ፤
ወደ እኔ ተመልከት፥ ይቅር በለኝም፤
ምልክትንም ለመልካም ከእኛ ጋር አድርግ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise by the Sons of Korah.

verses.text: Her foundations are in the holy mountains;
Rather than the dwellings of Jacob,
O city of God, concerning thee
I will remember Rahab and Babylon,
A man shall say of her, "Zion is our mother,"
The Lord shall bless His people;
All who dwell in thee shall rejoice as they are spoken of.

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise of the Sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician, upon Mahalath, a Song for the sons of Israel, a teaching of the sons of Emam.

verses.text: The Lord God of my salvation,
Let my prayer come before You,
For my soul is in great distress,
I have been counted with those who go down to the pit,
As though I were slain and in the grave,
In the darkness and in the shadow of death,
Your wrath has rested upon me,
Remove from me those who know me;
My eyes are dimmed with trouble;
Truly, will You perform wonders for the dead?
በመቃብርስ ውስጥ ያሉት ቸርነትህን፥
ተአምራትህ በጨለማ ይታወቃልን?
አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤
አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ለምን ትጥላለህ?
እኔ ድሃ ነኝ፥ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሮ ደከምሁ።
መቅሠፍት በላዬ አለፈ፥
ሁልጊዜ እንደ ውኃ ከበቡኝ፥
ወዳጆቼንና ባልንጀሮቼን

sections.title: The teaching of the Israelite Ethan.

verses.text: O Lord, I shall sing of Thy mercy forever.
"I shall proclaim mercy forever," Thou hast said.
I have made a covenant with those whom I have chosen.
I have prepared Thy seed forever.
O Lord, the heavens declare Thy glory.
Who can compare to the Lord God in the clouds?
The Lord is in the counsel of the saints; He is greatly to be feared.
O Lord, God of hosts, who is like unto Thee?
Thou art the one who rules the might of the sea.
Thou hast cast down the proud as if they were slain.
ሰማያት የአንተ ናቸው፥ ምድርም የአንተ ናት፤
ባሕርንና መስዕን አንተ ፈጠርህ፤
ክንድህ ከኀይልህ ጋር ነው፤
የዙፋንህ መሠረት ፍትሕና ርትዕ ነው፤
እልልታን የሚያውቅ ሕዝብ ብፁዕ ነው፤
በስምህ ቀኑን ሁሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥
የኀይላቸው ትምክሕት አንተ ነህና፥
ረድኤታችን ከእግዚአብሔር ነውና።
በዚያ ጊዜ ለልጆችህ በራእይ ተናገርህ፥
ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥
እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥
ጠላት በእርሱ ላይ አይጠቀምም፥
ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ አጠፋለሁ፥
እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥
እጁን በባሕር ላይ
እርሱ “አባቴ አንተ ነህ፥
እኔም ደግሞ በኵሬ አደርገዋለሁ፥
ለዘለዓለም ይቅርታዬን ለእርሱ እጠብቃለሁ፥
ዘሩንም ለዓለምና ለዘለዓለም፥
“ልጆቹ ግን ሕጌን ቢተዉ፥
Though they may break my covenant,
Their transgressions shall be upon their heads,
Yet my forgiveness I shall not withhold from him,
Nor shall I break my covenant.
As David was not cast away,
His seed shall endure forever,
And like the moon, it shall be established forever.
But thou art the one who has rejected, and hast turned away,
Thou hast forsaken the covenant of thy servant,
Thou hast broken down all his defenses.
All paths have been made crooked,
And the right hand of thine adversaries hath been lifted high.
Thou hast returned the sword's deliverance,
And hast cast away the purity thereof,
Thou hast shortened the days of thine own appointed time,
O Lord, how long wilt Thou hide Thy face forever?
What is my strength that I should hope?
Who is he that liveth and shall not see death?
O Lord, where is Thy former mercy?
O Lord: the reproach of those whom Thy servants have cast out,
O Lord, those who oppose You have driven me away.
Blessed be the Lord God forever and ever. Amen and Amen.

sections.title: A prayer of Moses, the man of God.

verses.text: O Lord, Thou art a refuge for all generations of children.
Before the mountains were born, and the earth and the world were formed,
Do not return man to humiliation;
A thousand years in Thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past,
The years before Thee are as a watch in the night.
It shall be as a dream that passeth away;
We are not consumed by Thy wrath,
Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee,
All our days have passed away in Thy wrath;
The span of our years is seventy years.
Who knows the power of Thy wrath?
Let us learn wisdom in our hearts.
O Lord, how long shall we return?
In the morning, we shall seek Thy mercy;
In the time of our affliction, Thou hast shown us mercy;
Behold Thy servants and Thy work;
May the light of our God, the Lord, be upon us.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, a song of praise.

verses.text: In the highest refuge shall He deliver you,
O Lord, "You are my refuge and my fortress;
He shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler,
He shall cover you with His feathers,
From the terror of the night,
From the evil work that walks in darkness,
A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; it shall not come near you.
Only with your eyes shall you look,
O Lord, You are my hope;
No evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your dwelling.
በመንገድህ ሁሉ ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ
እግርህም በድንጋይ እንዳትሰናከል
በተኵላና በእባብ ላይ ትጫናለህ፤
በእኔ ተማምኖአልና አድነዋለሁ
ይጠራኛል እመልስለትማለሁ፥
ረዥም ዕድሜን አጠግበዋለሁ፥

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise for the Sabbath Day.

verses.text: It is good to trust in the Lord.
In the morning, Your mercy,
in the season of spring, where there are ten harvests,
O Lord, for in Your work, You have made me rejoice;
O Lord, Your work is exceedingly great;
A foolish man does not understand;
the wicked are like chaff in the wind;
O Lord, You are indeed exalted forever;
O Lord, behold, Your enemies shall perish;
One day shall be as a thousand days, and it shall be lifted high.
Mine eyes have seen upon my adversaries,
But the righteous shall be as bold as a lion,
They are planted within the house of the Lord,
At that time, they shall flourish in goodly abundance;
Our God, the Lord, shall speak as He is true.

sections.title: A Psalm of Praise for the Sabbath Day.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ ክብሩንም ለበሰ፤
አቤቱ፥ ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀ ነው፥
አቤቱ፥ ወንዞች ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ፥
ከብዙ ውኆች ድምፅ የተነሣ
ምስክርህ እጅግ የታመነ ነው፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David for the Fourth Sabbath.

verses.text: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ተበቃይ ነው፥
የምድር ፈራጅ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤
አቤቱ፥ ኃጥኣን እስከ መቼ?
ይከራከራሉ፥ ዐመፃንም ይናገራሉ፤
አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብህን አዋረዱ፥
ባልቴቲቱንና ድሃ አደጉን ገደሉ፥
“እግዚአብሔር አያይም፥
ሰነፎች ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤
ጆሮን የተከለው አይሰማምን?
አሕዛብንስ የሚገሥጸው፥
የጠቢባን ዐሳብ ከንቱ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል።
አቤቱ፥ አንተ የገሠጽኸው
ከክፉዎች ዘመናት ይወገድ ዘንድ
እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥላቸውምና፥
ፍርድ ለእውነተኛ እስኪመለስ ድረስ፥
ስለ ክፉዎች ማን ይከራከርልኛል?
እግዚአብሔር የረዳኝ ባይሆን
እግሮች ተሰናከሉ ባልሁ ጊዜ፥
አቤቱ ለልቤ እንደ መከራዋ ብዛት፥
በሕግ ላይ ድካምን የሚፈጥር፥
የጻድቅን ነፍስ ያድናታል፥
እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያዬ ሆነኝ፥
እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ክፋታቸው ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላቸዋል፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበለን፤
በእምነት ወደ ፊቱ እንድረስ፥
አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነውና፥
እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥላቸውምና፤
ባሕር የእርሱ ናትና፥ እርሱም ፈጥሯታልና።
ኑ፥ እንስገድ ለእርሱም እንገዛ፤
እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና፥ እኛ ግን ሕዝቡ የማሰማርያውም በጎች ነን።
በምድረ በዳ እንደ ተፈታተኑትና እንዳስቈጡት ጊዜ፥
የተፈታተኑኝ አባቶቻችሁ
“ይችን ትውልድ አርባ ዓመታት ተቈጥቻት ነበር፥
And I shall not allow them to enter into my rest, for I am filled with wrath.

sections.title: And it came to pass after the completion of the house.

verses.text: Give unto the Lord a new song of praise;
Praise the Lord, and bless His name;
Declare His glory among the nations;
The Lord is great, and greatly to be praised;
For all the gods of the nations are but idols;
Faith and goodness are before Him;
O ye families of the nations, bring unto the Lord;
Bring glory unto the Lord for His name;
Worship the Lord in His holy place;
Let the Lord speak as He has decreed unto the nations.
The heavens shall rejoice, and the earth shall be glad;
The wilderness and all that is therein shall rejoice;
For He shall come; for He shall come to judge the earth;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when the earth returned.

verses.text: The Lord is angry; the earth shall tremble greatly.
The clouds and the storm surround Him;
Fire shall go before Him;
The flames shall light the world;
The mountains shall melt like wax before the Lord;
The heavens declare His righteousness;
For all who are devoted to the graven image;
O Lord, for Your judgment, Zion shall rejoice;
You, O Lord, alone are exalted above all the earth;
Those who love the Lord, hate evil.
Light is for the righteous,
The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: Give unto the Lord a new song of praise,
The Lord hath shown us His salvation.
He remembered His mercy unto Jacob, and His truth unto the house of Israel;
Let all the earth sing praises unto the Lord.
Unto the Lord in the assembly,
with the sound of the trumpet and the voice of the heavens,
the sea is full of His glory,
and the rivers shall clap their hands together in unity,
for the earth shall rejoice in His judgment.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: The Lord is exalted; the nations rejoice.
The Lord is great in Zion;
All shall give thanks to Thy great name,
The glorious King loves justice;
Our Creator, the Lord, is high and lifted up,
Moses and Aaron are holy in their priesthood;
They spoke to them from the cloud;
O Lord, our God, Thou hast heard them;
Our God, the Lord, is high and lifted up.

sections.title: A Psalm of Thanksgiving.

verses.text: በምድር ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥
በደስታም ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፥
እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላካችን እንደ ሆነ ዕወቁ፤
ወደ ደጆቹ በመገዛት፥
እግዚአብሔር ቸር፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘለዓለም፥

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, I will sing of Your mercy and judgment.
I will sing, and I will consider the path of the righteous;
Before my eyes, I shall not behold any wicked thing;
My heart shall not be taken by any deceitful matter;
I will destroy him who secretly slanders his neighbor;
With me, he shall not dwell;
He who acts proudly shall not abide in my house;
All who commit iniquity, I will cut off from the city of the Lord.

sections.title: When I lifted my supplication before the Lord, in the time of my distress, it was of a spiritual nature.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥
በመከራዬ ቀን ፊትህን ከእኔ አትመልስ፤
ዘመኔ እንደ ጢስ አልቋልና፥
ተቀሠፍሁ ልቤም እንደ ሣር ደረቀ።
ከጩኸቴ ድምፅ የተነሣ ሥጋዬ በአጥንቶቼ ላይ ተጣበቀ።
እንደ ሜዳ አህያ ሆንኹ፤
ተጋሁ፥ በሰገነትም እንደሚኖር ብቸኛ ድንቢጥ ሆንሁ።
ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሰድቡኛል፥
አመድን እንደ እህል ቅሜአለሁና፥
ከቍጣህ መቅሠፍት የተነሣ፥
ዘመኔም እንደ ጥላ አለፈ፤
አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ለዘለዓለም ትኖራለህ፥
አንተ ተነሥ፥ ጽዮንንም ይቅር በላት፥
ባሪያዎችህ ድንጋዮችዋን ወድደዋልና፥
አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ስምህን፥
እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ይሠራታልና፥
ወደ ድሆች ጸሎት ተመለከተ፥
ይህችም ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ተጻፈች፥
ከሰማይ ሆኖ መቅደሱን ተመልክቶአልና፥
የእስረኞችን ጩኸት ይሰማ ዘንድ፥
The name of the Lord shall be in Zion
The nations shall gather in unity at the appointed time
In the strength of His might, they shall return
In my time, do not forsake me;
O Lord, Thou hast established the earth from the beginning;
They shall perish, but Thou, O Lord, shalt endure;
But Thou art He, Thou art the same;
The children of Thy servants shall dwell therein;

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: My soul shall praise the Lord.
My soul shall praise the Lord,
He who forgives all your iniquities;
He who redeems your life from destruction,
He who satisfies your desires with good things,
The Lord is gracious and merciful;
He showed the way to Moses,
The Lord is a refuge and will not forsake,
He will never abandon,
As He has not dealt with us according to our sins.
As the heavens are higher than the earth,
So is the east far from the west,
As a father shows compassion to his children,
For He knows our creation;
Man is like grass in his days;
His soul shall depart from him,
But the mercy of the Lord endures from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him,
Who keep His commandments,
The Lord has prepared His throne in the heavens,
You who fulfill His word, O mighty and strong.
The host of all,
All the creatures in every place of His dominion,

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: My soul shall give thanks unto the Lord.
Thou hast clothed me with light as with a garment.
He who worketh in the waters,
the angelic spirits,
that they may not depart forever.
The proud is as a garment that is torn.
From thy service, they shall flee.
They shall go forth unto the mountains.
Thou hast made a boundary that they may not pass over.
He sendeth forth the fountains unto the valleys.
They shall consume all the beasts of the forest,
And the birds of the heavens shall dwell therein;
They shall consume the mountains from within them;
To bring forth the grain from the earth;
And wine shall gladden the heart of man;
All the trees of the forest,
Therein shall the owls make their nests;
The steep mountains for the wild goats;
You created the moon in its season;
You shall bring forth darkness, and the night shall be.
የአንበሶች ግልገሎች ያገሣሉ፥ ይነጥቃሉም፥
ፀሐይ ስትወጣ ይገባሉ፥
ሰው ወደ ተግባሩ ይሰማራል፥
አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ታላቅ ነው፤
ይህች ባሕር ታላቅና ሰፊ ናት፤
በዚያ ላይ መርከቦች ይሄዳሉ፥
ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ
በሰጠሃቸውም ጊዜ ይሰበስባሉ፤
ፊትህን ብትመልስ ግን ይደነግጣሉ፤
መንፈስህን ትልካለህ፥ ይፈጠራሉም፥
የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ለዘለዓለም ይሁን፤
ምድርን ያያል፥ እንድትንቀጠቀጥም ያደርጋል፤
በሕይወቴ ሳለሁ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግነዋለሁ፥
በቃሌም ደስ አሰኘዋለሁ፥
ኃጥኣን ከምድር ይጠፋሉ፥

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord, and call upon His name;
Let them take refuge in Him, and sing praises to Him;
In His holy name shall you glorify Him.
Blessed is the heart that seeks the Lord;
Remember the wondrous works He has done;
The servants are of the seed of Abraham;
He is the Lord our God;
His covenant is everlasting;
For Abraham, He has performed wonders;
For Jacob, He established a testimony.
For Israel, an everlasting covenant shall endure;
They are indeed very few in number;
From people to people;
A man shall not be moved to commit violence against them;
Do not forget those who have received them;
He brought famine upon the earth;
He sent a man before them;
Their feet were made like iron;
The word did not reach;
He sent a king, and he was struck down;
And the Lord of the house did so,
That all the rulers might be humbled like unto him,
And Israel went down into Egypt,
And He greatly multiplied His people,
That the people might be oppressed,
His servant Moses,
He spoke the word of the mighty unto them,
And He sent darkness, and it was darkened upon them;
He turned their water into blood,
Their land was in the houses of their kings.
እርሱ ተናገረ፥ የውሻ ዝንብ
ዝናባቸውን በረዶ አደረገው፥
ወይናቸውንና በለሳቸውን መታ፥
ተናገረ፥ አንበጣም፥
የምድራቸውንም ፍሬ ሁሉ በላ
የሀገራቸውንም በኵር ሁሉ ገደለ።
ከወርቅና ከብር ጋርም አወጣቸው፥
ፈርተዋቸው ነበርና
ደመናን ጋርዶ ሰወራቸው።
ለመኑ፥ ድርጭትም መጣ፥
ዓለቱን ሰነጠቀ ውኃንም አመነጨ፤
ለባሪያው ለአብርሃም የነገረውን
ሕዝቡንም በደስታ
የአሕዛብንም ሀገሮች ሰጣቸው፥
ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: For He is good, and His mercy endures forever.
Who can speak of the power of the Lord?
Those who keep justice,
O Lord, remember Your people with Your mercy.
Let me behold the goodness of those whom You have chosen.
We have sinned with our fathers.
Our fathers did not remember Your wonders while they were in the land of Egypt.
To show them His might,
And the sea of Eritrea He caused to dry up; it was parched.
And He delivered them from the hand of their enemies.
They who have caused them to be troubled, their water has been troubled,
At that time, they believed in His word,
And they hastened, and their work was accomplished,
In the wilderness, they desired their longing,
And He gave them what they did not ask for;
Moses, too, and Aaron, whom the Lord had sanctified,
The earth was opened, and Dathan was swallowed,
In their congregation, fire was kindled,
And in Horeb, they made a rebellion,
And the clay was consumed as a cow's example.
ያዳናቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ረሱ።
ድንቅንም በካም ምድር፥
እንዳያጠፋቸው የቍጣውን መቅሠፍት ይመልስ ዘንድ
የተወደደችውንም ምድር ናቁ፥
በድንኳኖቻቸውም ውስጥ አንጐራጐሩ፤
እጁንም አነሣባቸው።
ዘራቸውንም በአሕዛብ መካከል ይጥል ዘንድ፥
በብዔል ፌጎርም ዐለቁ፥
በሥራቸውም አነሣሱት
ፊንሐስም ተነሥቶ አዳናቸው፥
That which is righteous shall be counted for the son of man unto everlasting generations.
In the waters of strife, they have been cast out.
For His spirit hath been troubled.
And the Lord did not forsake the nations as He had said unto them.
They were joined with the nations, and they learned their works.
They sold themselves for their idols, and they became guilty.
The men sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto the idols.
They shed innocent blood.
And in their works, He was grieved.
And the Lord was angry with His people.
And He delivered them into the hand of their enemies.
Their enemies afflicted them,
Many times they were distressed;
As they were troubled, they turned their gaze toward Him,
And He remembered His covenant with them.
In their darkness, He granted them mercy before Him.
Our God, O Lord, save us;
From everlasting to everlasting.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord;
The Lord shall deliver them,
from the east and from the west, from the wilderness and from the sea;
In the dry land where there is no water, they shall be gathered;
Let them be gathered, let them be filled,
in the time of their distress, they cried unto the Lord,
and they shall go to the land where they dwell;
the mercy of the Lord
has taken hold of our souls,
for they have sat in darkness and in the shadow of death.
Concerning the word of the Lord, they were troubled;
Their hearts were distressed by affliction;
In the time of their distress, they cried out to the Lord;
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death;
The mercy of the Lord;
He has gathered their outcasts;
He received them from the path of wickedness;
Their bodies were all afflicted with hunger;
In the time of their distress, they cried out to the Lord;
He sent His word and healed them;
The mercy of the Lord
Let the offerings of praise be brought forth,
They who go down to the sea in ships,
They see the works of the Lord,
He spoke, and the stormy wind arose,
They mount up to the heavens; they go down to the depths;
They are glad because they are quieted, and He guides them to their desired haven.
In their distress, they cried unto the Lord,
He made the storm a calm,
And the waves thereof were still; they rejoiced in their gladness.
የእግዚአብሔርን ምሕረቱን
በአሕዛብ ጉባኤ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጉታል፥
ወንዞችን ምድረ በዳ አደረገ፥
በተቀመጡባት ሰዎች ክፋት
ምድረ በዳውን ለውኃ መውረጃ፥
በዚያም ራብተኞችን አስቀመጠ፥
እርሻዎችንም ዘሩ፥ ወይኖችንም ተከሉ፥
ባረካቸውም፥ እጅግም በዙ፤
እነርሱ በክፉ መከራና በጭንቀት ተሠቃዩ፥ እያነሱም ሄዱ፤
በአለቆችም ላይ ኀሣር ፈሰሰ፥
ችግረኛንም በችግሩ ረዳው፤
ቅኖች ይዩ፥ ደስም ይበላቸው፤
ይህን የሚጠብቅ ጥበበኛ ማን ነው?

sections.title: A Psalm of David, a song of praise.

verses.text: My heart is steadfast, O Lord, my heart is steadfast;
My glory shall return unto me, for I have been in the garden and in the wilderness;
O Lord, I give thanks unto Thee among the nations;
Thy mercy is great in the heavens,
and the Lord is high above the heavens;
And let Thy friends be blessed.
The Lord spoke in His sanctuary,
He is my strength, and He is my song;
The priest of Moab is my hope,
Who shall lead me unto the strong city?
O Lord, art Thou not he who hath forsaken us?
In our affliction, grant us deliverance;
In the strength of the Lord, we shall act;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: O Lord, do not turn away my prayer in vain,
For the mouth of the oppressor and the mouth of the sinner have risen against me.
With deceit they have surrounded me; with vanity they have attacked me.
In the face of their hatred, they have cast me down; yet I will call upon You.
In a good face, let evil be turned away from me.
Let the wicked be cast down upon the earth;
And in the time of calamity, let them be driven away.
May their days be few;
And may their children be beggars in the streets.
May their children wander and be driven away, may they seek and not find.
The debtor shall be stripped of all his wealth,
And he shall not find assistance;
His children shall be forsaken;
The iniquity of the father shall be remembered before God;
And before God, may he always remain;
For I have not considered to do evil;
Choose the path of righteousness, and unto Him shall you turn;
As a garment is put on,
Like the garment that is worn;
This work is before God, for they shall cast me down.
But You, O Lord, my Master, for Your name's sake
I am poor and needy,
as I have passed through troubles,
the garments have become worn out from fasting;
and I have been cast out among them;
O Lord, my God, help me,
O Lord, may Your hand be as it is;
they shall be troubled, but You shall bless;
let them be clothed with shame and disgrace;
I will greatly give thanks to the Lord with my mouth.
Let my soul be delivered from those who honor it.

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord my Lord, until I bring your enemies as a footstool for your feet.
The Lord shall send the rod of His strength out of Zion;
Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power,
The Lord is at thy right hand;
He shall judge among the nations;
Drink from the brook in the way;

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ በቅኖች ሸንጎ በጉባኤም
የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ታላቅ ናት፥
ሥራው ምስጋናና የጌትነት ክብር ነው።
ለጌትነቱ መታሰቢያን አደረገ፤
ለሚፈሩት ምግብን ሰጣቸው፤
የአሕዛብን ርስት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ
የእጆቹ ሥራ እውነትና ቅን ነው፤
ለዘለዓለምም የጸና ነው፥
እግዚአብሔርም መድኀኒትን ለሕዝቡ ላከ፥
የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፥

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥
ዘሩ በምድር ላይ ኀያል ይሆናል፤
ክብርና ባለጠግነት በቤቱ ነው፥
ለቅኖች ብርሃን በጨለማ ወጣ፤
ርኅሩኅ፥ ይቅር ባይና ቸር ሰው
ለዘለዓለም አይታወክም፤
ከክፉ ነገርም አይፈራም፤
በጠላቶቹ ላይ እስኪያይ ድረስ
በተነ፥ ለችግረኞችም ሰጠ፤
ኀጢአተኛም አይቶ ይቈጣል፥

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: O servants of the Lord, give thanks to Him,
from this day forth and unto the ages of ages.
From the rising of the sun to its setting.
The Lord is exalted over all nations,
Who is like our God, as the Lord?
He who beholds the humble in heaven and on earth;
He who lifts the poor from the dust,
with the rulers and with the people, He dwells among them;
He who makes His abode in the house.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Israel from Egypt,
Judah is His sanctuary,
The sea saw it and fled;
The mountains skipped like rams;
O sea, why did you flee?
And you, O mountains, like rams,
Before the God of Jacob.
The earth trembled and the waters flowed,
It is not for us, O Lord, it is not for us,
The nations say, "Where is their God?"
Our God is in heaven above;
The idols of the nations are of gold and silver,
They have mouths, but they do not speak;
They have ears, but they do not hear;
They have hands, but they do not handle;
There is no breath in their mouths;
O children of Israel, trust in the Lord;
O children of Aaron, trust in the Lord;
O you who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord;
O Lord, remember us and bless us.
Those who fear the Lord,
The Lord is upon you,
And you created the heavens and the earth,
The heaven of heavens belongs to the Lord;
O Lord, the dead do not praise You,
But we, the living, from this day forth even unto eternity.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር የልመናዬን ድምፅ ሰምቶአልና ወደድሁት።
ጆሮውን ወደ እኔ አዘንብሎአልና
የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥
የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራሁ፦
እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ጻድቅ ነው።
እግዚአብሔር ሕፃናትን ይጠብቃል፤
ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትሽ ተመለሺ፥
ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ ዓይኔንም ከእንባ፥
በሕያዋን ሀገር እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው ዘንድ።
በተናገርሁት አመንሁ፤
እኔም ከራሴ ጀምሮ፥ “ሰው ሁሉ ሐሰተኛ ነው” አልሁ።
ስላደረገልኝ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምንን እከፍለዋለሁ?
የሕይወትን ጽዋ እቀበላለሁ፥
በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እሰጣለሁ።
የጻድቅ ሞት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የከበረ ነው።
አቤቱ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥
ለአንተ የምስጋና መሥዋዕትን እሠዋለሁ፥
በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት
በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ፥

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: O all ye nations, give thanks unto the Lord,
For His mercy endureth upon us;

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good;
For His mercy endures forever;
For His mercy endures forever;
For His mercy endures forever;
In the time of my distress, I called upon the Lord;
The Lord is my helper; I shall not fear; what can man do to me?
The Lord is my helper; behold, I shall look upon my adversaries.
It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.
It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.
