All nations surrounded me;
Honor me, for I have honored You,
As the bee honors the honey, honor me,
For I have been humbled;
My strength is the name of the Lord,
The voice of joy is in the righteous,
The right hand of the Lord has exalted me greatly;
I shall not die, but I shall live,
The Lord has chastened me;
Open to me the gates of righteousness;
This is the gate of the Lord;
ሰምተኸኛልና፥
ግንበኞች የናቋት ድንጋይ፥
ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆነች፥
እግዚአብሔር የሠራት ቀን ይህች ናት፤
አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አድን፤
በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚመጣ ቡሩክ ነው፤
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠልን፤
አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፥ አመሰግንህማለሁ።
እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፥

sections.title: Aleph.

verses.text: They are pure in their ways,
Those who seek Your testimony,
Yet they do not walk in Your way while performing righteousness.
Let them keep Your commandments diligently, for You have commanded them.
I will keep Your law,
and I will regard all Your commandments.
O Lord, hear the judgment of Your righteousness,
and I will keep Your law.

sections.title: House.

verses.text: How shall we prepare the way for the Lord?
With all my heart, I have sought You,
that I may not be put to shame before You.
O Lord, You are blessed;
I have declared all Your judgments with my mouth.
Like a light shining forth in all things,
I have meditated upon Your commandments,
I will ponder Your statutes.

sections.title: Gamal.

verses.text: ሕያው እንድሆን ቃልህንም እንድጠብቅ
ዓይኖችን ክፈት፥
እኔ በምድር ስደተኛ ነኝ፤
ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ ፍርድህን እጅግ ናፈቀች።
ከትእዛዛትህ የሚርቁ ርጉማን ናቸው።
ትእዛዝህን ፈልጌአለሁና
አለቆች ደግሞ ተቀምጠው እኔን አሙኝ፤
ምስክርህም ትምህርቴ ነው፥

sections.title: Daleth.

verses.text: My body hath been laid low to the earth;
I will declare Thy way and Thy testimony;
Cause me to walk in the way of Thy truth;
My body hath not been comforted, for I am lifted up from sorrow;
Keep far from me the way of destruction;
I have chosen the way of Thy truth;
O Lord, I have followed Thy testimony; forsake me not.
In the time when Thou dost make my heart to be troubled,

እርስዋን ወድጃለሁና
ልቤን ወደ ምስክርህ መልስ፥
ከንቱ ነገርን እንዳያዩ ዐይኖቼን መልስ፤
እንዲፈራህ ለባሪያህ በቃልህ የተናገርኸውን አጽና።
ፍርድህ መልካም ነውና
እነሆ፥ ትእዛዝህን ናፈቅሁ፥

sections.title: Woe.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ይምጣልኝ፥
በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና
በፍርድህም ታምኛለሁና
ለዘለዓለም ዓለም
ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና
በነገሥታት ፊት ምስክርህን እናገራለሁ፥ አላፍርምም፤
እጅግም የወደድኋቸውን ትእዛዛትህን እናገራለሁ።
እጆቼንም ወደ ወደድኋቸው ወደ ትእዛዛትህ አነሣለሁ፤

sections.title: Zion.

verses.text: Remember the word which Thou hast spoken unto Thy servant, wherein Thou hast given me hope.
Thy word hath quickened me.
The proud have greatly erred.
I have considered Thy ancient judgments.
I am afflicted with sorrow, for I have forsaken Thy law.
In my sojourning, Thy judgment hath become my song.
O Lord, in the night I remember Thy name.
I seek Thy commandments; let this be my portion.

sections.title: Heath.

verses.text: The Lord is my portion;
O my God, with all my heart I seek You;
I reflect upon Your ways;
I strive to keep Your commandments, and I have not been led astray.
The cords of the wicked have entangled me;
For Your judgments of righteousness, I give You thanks.
I am for all who fear You;
O Lord, Your mercy fills the whole earth;

sections.title: Blessed be.

verses.text: O Lord, according to Thy word,
I shall trust in Thy commandments;
I was troubled, yet I found peace;
O Lord, Thou art gracious;
The arrogance of the proud has risen against me;
Their hearts are like wax, melted;
Let me know Thy judgment,
more than gold and silver from the greedy.

sections.title: Jude.

verses.text: Your hands have made me; do not forsake me.
For I trust in Your word.
O Lord, Your judgment is righteous.
Let Your mercy be for my joy.
Your law is my teaching.
The proud have dug pits for me; let them fear.
Let those who fear You and know Your testimonies return to me.
Let my heart be blameless in Your judgment.

sections.title: Caph.

verses.text: My soul has passed into Your paradise;
When shall I be comforted, I say?
For I have become like a withered plant;
How many are the days of Your servant?
Speak to me, O Lord, of Your mighty deeds;
All Your commandments are truth;
There were but a few left to perish from the earth;
As Your mercy, make me alive;
O Lord, Your word shall endure in heaven forever.
Your truth is to the generation of generations;
ሁሉን ገዝተሃልና
ሕግህ ትምህርቴ ባይሆን፥
በእርሱ ሕያው አድርገኸኛልና
እኔ የአንተ ነኝ፥ ፍርድህን ፈልጌአለሁና አድነኝ።
ኃጥኣን ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ጠበቁኝ፤
የሥራውን ሁሉ ፍጻሜ አየሁ፤

sections.title: Amen.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ሕግህን እንደምን እጅግ ወደድሁ!
ለዘለዓለም ለእኔ ነውና
ትእዛዝህ ትምህርቴ ነውና
ትእዛዝህን ፈልጌአለሁና
ቃልህን እጠብቅ ዘንድ
አንተ አስተምረኸኛልና ከፍርድህ አልራቅሁም።
ቃልህ ለጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው፤
ከትእዛዝህ የተነሣ አስተዋልሁ፤

sections.title: No.

verses.text: Thy law is a lamp unto my feet,
I will keep thy righteous judgments, and I will not forget them.
I have greatly suffered,
O Lord, let the words that proceed from my mouth be pleasing in thy sight,
My soul is ever in thy hand;
Deliver me from the wicked and the deceitful.
For it is the joy of my heart,
Forever and ever shall it be without end.

sections.title: Psalm.

verses.text: ዐመፀኞችን ጠላሁ፥ ሕግህን ግን ወደድሁ።
አንተ ረዳቴና መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥
እናንተ ዐመፀኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥
እንደ ቃልህ ተቀበለኝ፥ ሕያውም እሆናለሁ፤
ርዳኝም፥ አድነኝም፥
ምኞታቸው ዐመፃ ነውና
የምድር ኃጥኣን ሁሉ ወንጀለኞች ናቸው፤
መፈራትህን በሥጋዬ ውስጥ አስማማ፤

sections.title: Amen.

verses.text: ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ሠራህ፤
ባሪያህን በመልካም ጠብቀው፤
ዐይኖቼ ለማዳንህ፥
ለባሪያህ እንደ ምሕረትህ አድርግ፥
እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥
ለእግዚአብሔር የሥራ ጊዜ አለው፥
ስለዚህ ከወርቅና ከዕንቍ ይልቅ ትእዛዝህን ወደድሁ።
ስለዚህ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ሁሉ አቀናሁ፥

Your word shall shine forth,
I opened my mouth, and I poured out my heart;

sections.title: Zadok.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፥
ምስክርህን በጽድቅ አዘዝህ፥
ጠላቶቼ ትእዛዝህን ረስተዋልና
ቃልህ እጅግ የጋለ ነው፥
እኔ ታናሽና የተናቅሁ ነኝ፥
ጽድቅህም የዘለዓለም ጽድቅ ነው፥
መከራና ችግር አገኙኝ፤
ምስክርህ ለዘለዓለም እውነት ነው፤

sections.title: Behold.

verses.text: With a perfect heart I cried out, O Lord, hear me;
I cried unto Thee, O Lord, hear me and deliver me.
I reached unto the mountains, and I cried out.
Mine eyes were opened to behold.
O Lord, according to Thy mercy, hear my prayer;
In the year of my affliction, they drew near unto me;
O Lord, Thou art near unto me;
For ever and ever, as Thou art their foundation.

sections.title: Res.

verses.text: ሕግህን አልረሳሁምና
ፍርዴን ፍረድ አድነኝም፤
ሕይወት ከኃጥኣን የራቀ ነው፥
አቤቱ፥ ይቅርታህ እጅግ የበዛ ነው፤
የከበቡኝና ያስጨነቁኝ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤
ቃልህን አልጠበቁምና
ትእዛዝህን እንደ ወደድሁ ተመልከት፤
የቃልህ መጀመሪያ እውነት ነው፥

sections.title: San.

verses.text: The rulers have troubled me in vain;
I rejoice in Your word, for I have found much comfort.
I have pursued the wicked, and I have been afflicted;
For Your righteous judgment, I give You thanks seven times a day.
Great peace have they who love Your name;
O Lord, I have placed my hope in Your salvation;
My soul has kept Your testimonies;
O Lord, all Your ways are before You.

sections.title: Amen.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ልመናዬ ወደ አንተ ትቅረብ፤
አቤቱ፥ ምልጃዬ ወደ ፊትህ ትድረስ፤
ፍርድህን አስተምረኸኛልና
ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ ጽድቅ ናቸውና፥
ትእዛዛትህን ወድጃለሁና
አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ናፈቅሁ፤
ነፍሴ ትኑርልኝ ላመስግንህም፥
እንደ ጠፋ በግ ተዘነጋሁ፤

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: O Lord, in the time of my distress I cried unto Thee, and Thou didst hear me.
From the hand of the oppressor, from the mouth of the wicked, O Lord, deliver my soul.
What shall they give thee for the thorn, O Lord?
Like the wild beasts of the desert, the mighty have gathered together.
My dwelling is far off; woe is unto me.
With those who seek peace.
I am peaceful.

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: I lifted my eyes to the hills;
My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to be moved;
Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
The Lord shall preserve you;
The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
The Lord shall preserve you from all evil;
From this time forth and even forevermore.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, the Song of Ascents.

verses.text: I rejoice at the thought of going to the house of the Lord.
O Jerusalem, our feet stand within thy gates.
Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together.
Those who dwell therein are united with her.
For they have set their thrones for judgment there.
Speak of the peace of Jerusalem.
May peace be within thy walls,
for the sake of my brethren and companions, for the sake of thee,
for the sake of my God, for the house of the Lord our God.

sections.title: The Psalm of the Ascents.

verses.text: O Thou who dwellest in the heavens, lift up our eyes unto Thee.
Behold, as the eyes of servants are unto the hand of their masters,
Have mercy, O Lord, have mercy;
the pride of the haughty and the downfall of the arrogant.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, a Song of Ascents.

verses.text: The Lord shall not be with us.
The Lord shall not be with us.
When they poured out their wrath upon us,
I was indeed in the water when they overwhelmed me;
Our souls have been delivered from the pit;
May the Lord be praised for those who have not been caught in the snare.
Our bodies, however, have been delivered like a bird from the fowler's snare;
Our deliverance has been wrought by Him who created the heavens and the earth.

sections.title: The Psalm of the Sabbath.

verses.text: በእግዚአብሔር የታመኑ እንደ ጽዮን ተራራ ናቸው፥
ተራሮች ይከቧታል፥
ጻድቃን እጃቸውን በዐመፃ እንዳይዘረጉ
አቤቱ፥ ለቸሮች፥ ልባቸውም ለቀና መልካምን አድርግ።
ወደ ጠማማነት የሚመለሱትን ግን

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥
በዚያን ጊዜ አፋችን ደስታን ሞላ፥
ደስተኞችም ሆን።
አቤቱ፥ በአዜብ እንዳሉ ፈሳሾች
በልቅሶ የሚዘሩ በደስታ ይሰበስባሉ።
በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ዘራቸውን ተሸክመው እያለቀሱ ተሰማሩ፤

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔር ቤትን ካልሠራ፥
በማለዳ መገሥገሣችሁም ከንቱ ነው።
እነሆ፥ ልጆች የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ናቸው፥
በኀያል እጅ እንዳሉ ፍላጾች፥
ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ምኞቱን የሚፈጽም ሰው ብፁዕ ነው፤

sections.title: The Psalm of the Ascents.

verses.text: All who fear the Lord,
You shall enjoy the fruit of your labor;
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house;
Behold, the man who fears the Lord shall be blessed in this manner.
The Lord bless you from Zion;
And you shall see the children of your children.

sections.title: The Psalm of the Ascents.

verses.text: Israel shall say, “From my youth, I have been continually forsaken;
From my youth, I have been continually forsaken;
The mighty have struck me upon my back;
The Lord is righteous;
All who seek Zion shall be put to shame;
Like a serpent upon the ground;
To him who would crush;
And as they pass along the way, let them say, “The blessing of the Lord be upon you.”

sections.title: The Psalm of the Morning.

verses.text: O Lord, I have called upon Thee from the depths.
O Lord, hear my voice;
O Lord, if Thou dost keep iniquity,
forgiveness is from Thee alone.
O Lord, for Thy name's sake I have hoped in Thee;
from the morning hour until the night.
Forgiveness is from God;
He shall deliver Israel from all his iniquities.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, a Song of Ascents.

verses.text: O Lord, let not my heart be troubled,
I have cast down my own self.
From this day forth, even unto the ages of ages.

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: O Lord, remember David and all his afflictions;
As it is said unto the Lord,
"I will not enter into the dwelling of my house,
nor will I give sleep to mine eyes, nor slumber to my eyelids,
until I find out a place for the Lord,
behold, we have heard of it in Ephrathah,
and now we shall go into the habitations of the Lord;
O Lord, arise unto Thy rest,
let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness,
for Thy servant David's sake.
እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊት እንዲህ ሲል በእውነት ማለ፥ አይጸጸትምም፥
ልጆችህ ኪዳኔን፥
እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን መርጦአታልና፥
“ይህች ለዘለዓለም ማረፊያዬ ናት፤
ባልቴቶችዋን እጅግ እባርካቸዋለሁ፥
ካህናቷንም ደኅንነትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥
በዚያ ለዳዊት ቀንድን አበቅላለሁ፥
ጠላቶቹንም እፍረትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፤

sections.title: The Psalm of the Evening.

verses.text: ወንድሞች በኅብረት ቢቀመጡ፥
ከራሱ ጀምሮ እስከ ጢሙ፥ በልብሱ መደረቢያ ላይ፥
በጽዮን ተራሮች እንደሚወርድ እንደ አርሞንዔምም ጠል ነው፤

sections.title: The Psalm of the Morning.

verses.text: In the house of the Lord, in the house of our God, where the ministers stand.
By night, in the house of the sanctuary, lift up your hands.
The Lord, who created the heavens and the earth.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks unto the name of the Lord;
Within the house of the Lord,
For the Lord is good; therefore, give thanks unto the Lord;
The Lord chose Jacob for Himself,
The Lord is great indeed;
In heaven and on earth, in the sea and in all the depths,
He brings forth the clouds from the earth;
All the firstborn of Egypt,
O Egypt, against thee, upon Pharaoh and all his servants,
He struck many nations.
የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥
ርስት ምድራቸውንም
አቤቱ፥ ስምህ ለዘለዓለም ነው፥
እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፥
የአሕዛብ ጣዖታት የብርና የወርቅ፥
አፍ አላቸው፥ ግን አይናገሩም፤
ጆሮ አላቸው፥ ግን አይሰሙም፤
የሚሠሩአቸው ሁሉ፥
የእስራኤል ወገኖች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፤
የሌዊ ወገኖች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፤
The Lord who dwells in Jerusalem.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፥
የአማልክትን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤
የጌቶችን ጌታ አመስግኑ፤
እርሱ ብቻውን ታላቅ ተአምራትን ያደረገ፤
ሰማያትን በጥበቡ የሠራ፤
ምድርን በውኃ ላይ ያጸና፤
ብቻውን ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራ፤
ለፀሐይ ቀንን ያስገዛው፤
ለጨረቃና ለከዋክብት ሌሊትን ያስገዛቸው፤
ከበኵራቸው ጋር ግብፅን የገደለ፥
He brought Israel out from among them;
With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm;
He split the sea of Eritrea completely;
He led Israel through the midst of it;
He cast Pharaoh and his army into the sea of Eritrea;
He guided the people through the wilderness;
He struck down great kings;
He killed mighty kings;
The king of the Amorites, Sihon;
The king of Bashan, Og;
The inheritance of their land
The Lord hath remembered us in our affliction;
And He hath delivered us from the hand of our enemies;
He giveth food to all flesh;
Let us give thanks to the God of heaven;
By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down;
We wept when we remembered Zion.
How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
O Jerusalem, if I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth.
If I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem;
who said, Raze it, raze it, even to the foundation thereof.
O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

sections.title: The Psalm of Haggai and Zechariah, the Psalm of David.

verses.text: O Lord, with a perfect heart I give thanks unto Thee,
and in Thy holy temple will I worship.
On the day I call upon Thee, answer me swiftly.
O Lord, all the kings of the earth shall give thanks unto Thee;
and in the Lord shall they sing praises.
For the Lord is high and exalted,
even in the midst of trouble, Thou wilt preserve me;
and the Lord shall deliver me.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the Chief Musician.

verses.text: O Lord, Thou hast tested me; Thou knowest me.
Thou art aware of my sitting down and my rising up.
Thou dost search out my longing and my path.
There is no word of iniquity upon my tongue.
O Lord, behold, Thou knowest all things, both the former and the latter.
Thy knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
Whither shall I go from Thy Spirit?
If I ascend into heaven, Thou art there;
if I take the wings of the morning and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
even there shall Thy hand lead me.
Truly, darkness shall cover me,
Darkness shall not overshadow you,
O Lord, for Thou hast created my being,
In fear, I have been made aware of Thy presence, O Lord; I give Thee thanks.
The work of my hands, which Thou hast fashioned, is not forgotten by Thee,
Even my unformed body, Thine eyes behold;
O Lord, Thy friends are greatly honored in my sight;
I shall praise them, for they are more than abundant.
O Lord, if Thou art the one who guides the mighty,
In their counsel, they shall prevail.
O Lord, shall I not be one who seeks Thee?
Let them pursue me with perfect malice, and let them be my adversaries.
O Lord, test me, and search my heart;
If iniquity be found in me, behold;

sections.title: A Psalm of David, for the chief musician.

verses.text: "O Lord, deliver me from the wicked man,
For they continually devise mischief in their hearts,
They speak with their mouths like serpents;
O Lord, preserve me from the hand of the wicked,
The proud have laid a snare for me,
And You, O God, are my refuge;
O Lord, my Master, the strength of my poverty,
O Lord, my Master, do not deliver me into the hands of the sinners who rise against my desire;
Let their own heads be covered with the calamity of their own making.
Let the fire of their wrath consume them."
ተናጋሪ ሰው በምድር ውስጥ አይጸናም፤
እግዚአብሔር ለድሆች ዳኝነትን
ጻድቃን ግን በእውነት ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ፤

sections.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ ስማኝ፤
ጸሎቴን በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ተቀበልልኝ፥
አቤቱ፥ ለአፌ ጠባቂ፥
ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አትመልሰው፥
በጽድቅ ገሥጸኝ፥ በምሕረትም ዝለፈኝ፥
ኀያላኖቻቸው በዓለት አጠገብ ተጣሉ፥
እንደ ጓል በምድር ላይ ተሰነጣጠቁ
አቤቱ፥ ጌታዬ፥ ዐይኖቼ ወደ አንተ ናቸውና፤
ከሰወሩብኝ ወጥመድ፥
እኔ ብቻዬን እስካልፍ ድረስ

sections.title: The teaching of David when he was in the wilderness.

verses.text: You cried out to the Lord;
I have poured out my supplication before Him;
When my body was in distress upon me,
I turned to my right and beheld,
O Lord, I cried out unto Thee:
I am greatly afflicted; look upon my supplication;
O Lord, I give thanks unto Thy name.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, when his son had rebelled against him.

verses.text: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፥
ሕያው ሁሉ በፊትህ አይጸድቅምና
ጠላት ነፍሴን ከብቦአታልና
ሰውነቴ በላዬ አለቀችብኝ፥
የቀድሞውን ዘመን ዐሰብሁ፥
እጆቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፤
አቤቱ፥ ፈጥነህ ስማኝ፥ ሰውነቴ አልቃለች፤
አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታምኛለሁና፥
አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ተማጽኛለሁና
አቤቱ፥ አንተ አምላኬ ነህና ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ አስተምረኝ፤
አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤
በፈቃድህ ጠላቶቼን አጥፋቸው፥

sections.title: Concerning Goliath, the Psalm of David.

verses.text: Keep my hands, and my lips also guard.
He who delivers me, my refuge, my drink, and my comforter;
O Lord, what is man that You are mindful of him?
Man is like a vain thing;
O Lord, lower the heavens and come down;
Make Your lightning shine upon them, and in their sight;
Send Your hand from on high;
Their mouth speaks of vain things;
O Lord, I give You thanks with a new song;
To the kings, He who gives the healer;
Their mouths speak of vain things,
Their children are as new plants in their flourishing,
Their houses are filled with the abundance of their possessions,
For their graves are known;
Give thanks for such a people.

sections.title: A Psalm of David, a song of praise.

verses.text: አምላኬ ንጉሤ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፥
በየቀኑ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥
እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው፥ ምስጋናውም እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤
የልጅ ልጆች ሥራህን ያደንቃሉ፥
የቅድስናህንም ክብር ታላቅነት ይናገራሉ፥
“ኀይልህ ግሩም ነው” ይላሉ፥
የቸርነትህን ብዛት መታሰቢያ ይናገራሉ፥
እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ባይና መሓሪ ነው፥
እግዚአብሔር ለሚታገሡት ቸር ነው።
አቤቱ፥ ፍጥረትህ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፥
"To Your kingdom, honor is due," they say,
Your strength for the children of men.
Your kingdom is the kingdom of all eternity;
The Lord is faithful in all His words;
The eyes of all men look to You in hope;
Your right hand shall be exalted;
The Lord is righteous in all His ways;
The Lord is near to all who call upon Him;
He will fulfill the desires of those who fear Him;
The Lord preserves all who love Him;
አፌ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ይናገራል፤

sections.title: The Psalm of Haggai and Zechariah.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: My soul shall praise the Lord.
While I have life, I will praise the Lord;
Trust not in princes, nor in the sons of men, for they cannot save.
Their breath goes forth, they return to the earth;
The God of Jacob is their help,
He who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them.
He executes judgment for the oppressed;
The Lord lifts up those who are bowed down;
The Lord watches over the strangers;
The Lord shall reign forever.

sections.title: The Psalm of Haggai and Zechariah.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ መዝሙር መልካም ነውና።
እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይሠራታል፥
ልባቸው የቈሰለውን ይፈውሳል፥
ከዋክብትንም በሙሉ ይቈጥራቸዋል፥
እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው፥
እግዚአብሔር የዋሃንን ያነሣቸዋል፥
ለእግዚአብሔር በምስጋና ዘምሩ፥
ሰማዩን በደመናት የሚሸፍን፥
ለእንስሶችና ለሚጠሩት ለቍራዎች ጫጩቶች፥
የፈረስን ኀይል አይወድድም፥
እግዚአብሔር በሚፈሩት፥

sections.title: The Psalms of Haggai and Zechariah.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: O Jerusalem, praise the Lord your God,
O Zion, give thanks to your God;
For He has made peace for your children,
His word shall be sent forth to the earth,
He shall give snow like wool;
He shall scatter frost like ashes;
He shall send forth His word and it shall melt them;
His word to Jacob,
He has not done so for any other nation.

sections.title: The Psalms of Haggai and Zechariah.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: O give thanks to the Lord from the heavens;
All the angels shall give thanks to Him;
The sun and the moon shall give thanks to Him;
The heavens of heavens,
shall give thanks to the name of the Lord.
Forever and ever shall they stand;
All the serpents and creeping things,
fire and hail, snow and vapor,
mountains and all hills,
beasts and all cattle shall give thanks.
የምድር ነገሥታት፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ፥
ጐልማሶችና ደናግል፥
የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመሰግናሉ።
የሕዝቡንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፤

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord with a new song;
Israel shall rejoice in its Creator,
They shall praise His name with joy,
For the Lord delights in His people;
The righteous shall be adorned with His glory;
They shall give thanks to the Lord with their voices;
He shall act deceitfully against the nations,
And against their kings with a rod of iron;
He shall execute the written judgment upon them.

sections.title: Hallelujah.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord in His holy places;
Give thanks to Him for His mighty deeds;
Give thanks to Him with the sound of the trumpet;
Give thanks to Him with the harp and the lyre;
Let His voice be praised with a sweet melody;
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.

sections.title: A Psalm of David concerning himself.

verses.text: ከወንድሞቼ ይልቅ እኔ ትንሽ ነበርሁ፥
እጆቼ መሰንቆ ይመቱ ነበር።
ለጌታዬ ማን ነገረው?
እርሱ መልአኩን ልኮ አዳነኝ፥
ወንድሞቼ ግን፥ ያማሩና ያደጉ ነበሩ።
ልዩ ወገንን ልገጥመው ወጣሁ።
እኔም ከወንዝ ሦስት ድንጋዮችን አነሣሁ፥
በላዩ የነበረውንም ሰይፍ ወሰድሁ፥
